title: Sr Associate - Salesforce QA Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
The Salesforce QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of Salesforce applications and integrations. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in testing Salesforce solutions, with a particular focus on
**Salesforce CPQ functionality**
, expertise in QA automation, and a solid understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud. Exposure to Salesforce Billing is preferred, while experience with Service Cloud and Experience Cloud is desirable.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts for Salesforce applications, with a primary focus on Salesforce CPQ and Sales Cloud.
* Design, execute, and maintain functional, regression, integration, sanity, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for Salesforce implementations.
* Define test environment and test data requirements, and collaborate with development teams to ensure test readiness.
* Validate Salesforce CPQ business processes, including product configuration, pricing and product rules, quoting, approvals, amendments, renewals, and order management.
* Perform integration testing to ensure data accuracy and integrity across Salesforce objects and integrated systems.
* Prepare, automate, and execute regression test suites to maximize test coverage and improve release quality.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify defects early in the development lifecycle.
* Conduct sanity testing to ensure applications are production-ready before deployment.
* Track, prioritize, and report defects using Jira or similar tools, ensuring timely resolution.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and automation practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in functional and automation testing of Salesforce applications.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce CPQ functionality testing.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud business processes and functionality.
* Expertise in at least one QA automation tool, such as Provar, Selenium, or an equivalent automation framework.
* Experience in preparing test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test cases.
* Hands-on experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) and integration validation.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model, and platform customizations.
* Experience with regression test automation and test execution.
* Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Hands-on experience using Jira or similar defect management tools.
* Experience working in client-facing roles with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to Salesforce Billing functionality and testing.
* Experience conducting load and performance testing.
* Knowledge of Revenue Cloud processes.
* Experience validating Salesforce integrations with external applications.

**Desirable Skills**

* Exposure to Salesforce Service Cloud.
* Exposure to Salesforce Experience Cloud.
* Knowledge of Salesforce automation frameworks such as TestNG.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Provar Automation Certification
* Selenium WebDriver Certification
* Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator Certification

title: Assistant Quality Assurance Manager dairy
company: INDAPUR DAIRY AND MILK PRODUCTS LIMITED
description:
**Company Description**
INDAPUR DAIRY AND MILK PRODUCTS LIMITED is a growing food production company based in the Pune district of Maharashtra, India. The company focuses on dairy and milk products, serving a diverse customer base in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area and beyond. As part of the regional dairy industry, INDAPUR DAIRY emphasizes product quality, safety, and consistency. Team members have the opportunity to contribute to essential food supply chains and work with modern production practices in a dynamic environment.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Assistant Quality Assurance Manager role located in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area. The role involves monitoring and maintaining quality standards across dairy production processes, including raw material inspection, in-process checks, and finished product evaluation. The Assistant Quality Assurance Manager supports the development and implementation of quality protocols, assists with audits, and ensures compliance with food safety regulations and internal policies. Daily responsibilities include documenting quality records, coordinating with production and maintenance teams on corrective actions, and participating in continuous improvement initiatives. The role also requires training and guiding team members on quality procedures and contributing to problem-solving when deviations occur.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of quality assurance principles, food safety standards, and dairy production processes.
* Candidates should possess skills in data analysis, documentation, and report preparation related to quality metrics and compliance.
* Candidates should possess the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and support training on quality procedures.
* Candidates should possess problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced production environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Dairy Technology, Food Technology, Microbiology, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Prior experience in quality assurance or quality control within the dairy or food industry is an advantage.
* Familiarity with relevant regulatory standards (such as FSSAI and HACCP) and audit processes is beneficial.
* Willingness to work on-site in manufacturing conditions and adapt to shift or extended hours as operationally required.

title: Senior Engineer - Process Technology
description:
*Armacell provides numerous and diverse career opportunities. Add your talent to ours and make a difference around the world!*
**Purpose Of The Job**
To drive process technology excellence, manufacturing optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives across production operations by ensuring stable, efficient, and capable manufacturing process. The role is responsible for process parameter control, troubleshooting, material and recipe optimization, process development trials, quality improvement, waste reduction, and technology deployment while supporting Armacell's safety, sustainability, and operational excellence objectives.
  
  
**Key Dimensions**
Successful first pass quality (95%)
  
  
Density reduction (as per Budget/PAP)
  
  
Scrap reduction
  
  
Preparation of Fish bone diagram & RCA of the loss
  
  
Process Stability & trouble shooting
  
  
**Description Of Main Tasks**
The Incumbent is responsible for the following tasks:
  
  

* Process Control & Optimization
* Monitor, analyze, and improve key manufacturing process parameters to ensure product quality, productivity, and process stability.
* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve standard recipes, process parameters, and operating standards.
* Drive process capability improvement through statistical analysis, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Identify and implement opportunities for yield enhancement, density optimization, raw material savings, and scrap reduction.
* Support process standardization and manufacturing digitization initiatives.
* Operational Responsibilities:
* Issuing of std. recipe and process parameter sheet for production.
* Approval of raw materials and mixed compounds
* Conducting raw material replacement trials as per procedure
* Condcuting recipe change trials as per defined procedure
* Managing the toolings required for manufacturing
* Maintaining the calibration of testing equipments & liasoning with suppliers
* Maintaining Process Technology database & parameter file
* Connecting with APAC and Global Process Technology team for new developments
* Supporting Product development dept by executing trials and adhering to the timelines for development.
* Supporting Quality function for improving process capability of the processes
* Adhering to the crtical factors of the product and ensuring all parameters are in defined budgeted level
* Technical Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement
* Provide shopfloor technical support for process-related issues.
* Lead structured problem-solving activities using RCA methodologies such as Fishbone Analysis, 5 Why, DOE, FMEA, and CAPA.
* Ensure rapid resolution of process deviations and quality concerns.
* Drive continuous improvement projects focused on throughput, quality, productivity, energy efficiency, and cost optimization.
* Training & Development
* Training & Development of plant operators.
* To focus on development in the area of production process improvement and suggesting the preventive actions.
* To communicate effectively and assertively in order to avoid conflicts at work place.
* Quality & Compliance
* Ensure compliance with approved process specifications and critical product parameters.
* Support quality improvement initiatives to achieve targeted First Pass Yield and customer quality objectives.
* Manage process-related documentation, specifications, SOPs, and process databases.
* Support internal, customer, IMS, and compliance audits.
* Upkeeping department system manual & procedures
* Participating in monthly PPP audits and ensuring the PPP score > 98%
* Sustainability, Ethics and Operational Excellence (WAM)
* Promote sustainable and ethical practices
* Support the organization's sustainability and ESG objectives
* Participate actively in World Class Manufacturing (WCM/WAM) and continuous improvement programs.
* Drive Yield improvement Initiatives
* Drive process standardization and digitization initiatives.

**Job Specifications**
**Professional Education**
Diploma/ B.E/ B. Tech (Chemistry/ Rubber/Polymer / Mechanical), B.Sc. with CIPET.
  
  
**Professional Experience (how long)?**
6-10 yrs
  
  
**In which areas?**
Rubber processing industry in technical / process technology department.
  
  
**Other specific skills/ knowledge?**

* Knowledge of different chemical mix used in Rubber process,
* Result-oriented and proactive approach
* Coordination skills
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Problem-solving and analytical ability
* Hands on computers operations for database management.
* Basic understanding of Lean Manufacturing / continuous improvement

**Language Skills**
English, Hindi, Marathi or any other Indian Language
  
  
**Comments / Additional Requirements**
Proactive and self starter
  
  
Experienced in dynamic and fast-paced work environment
  
  
**Time Type**
Full time

title: Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems
description:
**Description**
At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Solution Engineer – Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems**
, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on
**Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)**
.
  
  
LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* Serve as the IT System Owner for Envalior's LIMS QA solutions.
* Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities.
* Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues.
* Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally.

**Partner with the Business**

* Develop a deep understanding of Quality, R&T, and Operational Technology processes.
* Collaborate with laboratory managers, quality teams, manufacturing stakeholders, and digital colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change.

**Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation**

* Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency, data management, automation, and operational performance.
* Simplify and modernize existing application landscapes.
* Eliminate waste, reduce complexity, and improve user experience through technology and process optimization.

**Enable Reliable Laboratory Operations**

* Support systems used for sample management, laboratory workflows, testing activities, and quality data management.
* Ensure effective system integrations between laboratory, manufacturing, and enterprise platforms.
* Help maintain accurate, timely, and accessible laboratory information across the value chain.
* Support the digital backbone that enables quality decision-making and product release activities.

**Lead Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to strengthen system performance and business processes.
* Promote best practices in application management, information architecture, and digital solutions.
* Support change management initiatives and user adoption activities.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement across supported domains.

**Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience in application management, solution engineering, business analysis, or related digital roles.
* Experience supporting Quality, Manufacturing, Laboratory, R&T, or Operational Technology environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working within global and cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Technical Expertise -**
**Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* ZhuoMES
* GUSLAB / LABSQ
* Unilab
* Thermo Fisher SampleManager LIMS
* WinLIMS

**OT & Manufacturing Solutions**

* Eschbach Shiftconnector
* AssetWise

**Sustainability & Quality Platforms**

* Credit360
* Other Quality, OT, and R&T SaaS applications

**Additional Capabilities**

* Information architecture (data, process, and application landscape)
* Application lifecycle management
* Systems integration and interfacing
* Change management
* Technical project delivery
* Analytical problem solving
* Operations, Quality, and R&T process knowledge

**What Success Looks Like**
In this role, you will become the trusted digital partner for Envalior's Quality and Laboratory community. You will ensure our LIMS landscape delivers reliable support to laboratories worldwide while helping the business embrace new technologies and more efficient ways of working.
  
  
**You Will Be Successful If You Can**

* Balance technology expertise with business understanding.
* Influence stakeholders through collaboration and credibility.
* Simplify complex challenges into practical solutions.
* Drive operational efficiency through digital innovation.
* Continuously improve the applications and processes that support Envalior's quality and laboratory operations.

**Benefits**
**Competitive Compensation**
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.
  
  
**Comprehensive Benefits**
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance & Flexibility**
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.
  
  
**Training & Development Opportunities**
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it’s only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.
  
  
**APPLY NOW!**
Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future.
  
  
Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu.Tripathi@envalior.com
  
  
*Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent.Acquisition@Envalior.com.
  
  
**OUR HERITAGE**
With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. Envalior is the brand new materials powerhouse that was Launched in early 2023.
  
  
We aim to be a global leader in sustainable and high-performance engineering materials. We imagine the future by shaping the world of today and tomorrow. We’re conscious that this is both a privilege and a responsibility – so, when we imagine the future, we’re guided by our key values to help us create a better world.

title: Customer Quality Deputy Manager  (M/F/D)
description:
* MISSION

****1.1. Enhance Awareness Of Customer Expectations By:****

* Maintaining a permanent dialogue with quality staff at the customer site
* Participating in periodic quality briefing meetings.
* Periodically distributing briefing notes to the Group.

**1.2. Eliminate line failures, in cooperation with the Divisions involved**

* Key point for the customer: ensure normal flow very quickly.
* Key points for the Divisions: characterize the problem in the QR PDCA, completing 5W2H, doing first level analysis and send it to concerned branches
* Speed-up the sending back of bad parts and if possible good part(s) to be compared with.
* Managing sorting operations (at Customer and on advanced platforms): put in place the needed resources, systematically prepare a detailed instruction sheet, follow the progress of the activity, reporting the time spent for each operation and sorting results.
* PDCA/FTA-LLC: Challenge the logical thinking of the PDCA analysis sent by the Divisions. If no progress done on PDCA improvement required, inform levels N+x (Division Functional Managers or Division Managers) and, if necessary, the Branch Functional Department concerned (see Appendix 11 for escalation process).
* Response time: should the plants or divisions fail to respond on time required by the Customer / Valeo, inform levels N+x (Division Functional Managers or Division Managers) and, if necessary, the Branch Functional Department concerned(see Appendix 11 for escalation process).

****1.3. Communicate With The Customer:****

* React quickly when customers’ contacts become dissatisfied and send information to Valeo sites
* Protect the customer by managing sorting operations, implementing surveys, preventive inspections,
* When review of PDCA analysis is requested by the Customer, present the PDCA/FTA-LLC with Division representatives (ie: APU manager, plant manager) or on behalf of the Divisions

* Project Team list, 3P Summary, Master Timing Plan, DFMEA and PFMEA summary, Product / Process Control plan,

* Confirm with Customer and Project Teams, Lessons Learned in current applications / customer plants that could be

* Assist Project Teams reactivity with clarification of open points applying regular communication, using 5W 2H.

* Alerting on any issue which could impact the launch (ie: logistics, mis-handling, assembly recommendations not
* respected)

* Facilitating communication between contacts at the Automaker site and the Valeo site during new product testing.
* However, the resident in no way replaces Valeo technical assistants dispatched to the customer site for the launching of a new
* product. Division assistance could be put in place until customer SOP + 3 months (could be extended 3 months in case of
* request from Customer or GRE ).

**1.6. Help make products easier to assemble and ensure that they are used properly by:**

* Informing the customer of the correct conditions of use and of Valeo's recommendations.
* Informing the plants of the actual conditions of use and their evolution.
* Detecting any Non-Conformance in the use of Valeo products at the customer site and immediately informing the
* customer.

* Percentage of Warranty Returns.

* Knowing how indicators are measured at the customer site and by keeping Valeo Divisions informed of possible
* changes.
* Knowing customer contacts who process and consolidate Quality data in IT systems, so as to help Valeo sites ensure

* Formalizing the numerous" in the field" quality data which is not covered by indicators.

* Process Optimization: Analyze end-to-end workflows to identify inefficiencies, championing the use of data and analytics to improve speed, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Data Governance & Quality Assurance
* Data Quality Rules: Define and monitor Critical Data Elements (CDEs), establish robust data quality rules, and drive the resolution of data quality issues.
* Lineage & Metadata: Document comprehensive data lineage, metadata, and data dictionaries to ensure full transparency and traceability of data across systems.
* Stakeholder & Change Management
* Stakeholder Engagement: Manage relationships and expectations with senior business sponsors, finance leaders, and risk managers, communicating progress and risks with transparency.

* Problem Solving: Strong analytical mindset with a proactive, structured approach to troubleshooting and problem-solving.
* Collaboration: Proven ability to work as a partner across diverse, global, and cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Analyst, Data Management, IT
description:
**Job Description**
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
As part of our IT team, your expertise will help Edwards strengthen trusted, governed, and high-quality master data across the enterprise. We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Data Management to support critical master data domains, including Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master, while helping modernize Edwards' Master Data Management capabilities from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS toward a multi-domain Semarchy MDM platform on Snowflake. This role combines data stewardship, governance, data quality, business analysis, and operational support with direct partnership across global and regional business teams.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Participate in the implementation and expansion of Semarchy MDM as a Snowflake-based, multi-domain enterprise Master Data Management platform.
* Support the onboarding of new master data domains and contribute to migration planning, business validation, testing, and user adoption as domains transition from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS to the future-state platform.
* Partner with MDM leadership, architects, engineers, data stewards, application teams, and business stakeholders to define scalable master data processes, governance models, stewardship workflows, and platform requirements.
* Support Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master domains operating on Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS, including application enhancements, release validation, testing, and production support.
* Investigate and resolve master data issues, data quality exceptions, match and merge conflicts, hierarchy requests, workflow issues, and data synchronization problems across upstream and downstream applications.
* Engage directly with regional business teams to understand business processes, data challenges, and master data requirements across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Elicit, document, validate, and translate business requirements into scalable data management and MDM solutions that business and technical teams can execute.
* Define, document, and maintain business rules, data standards, critical data elements, data definitions, stewardship procedures, and data quality controls.
* Perform data profiling, analysis, root cause investigation, and remediation activities using SQL, Snowflake, and related data tools.
* Develop and monitor data quality metrics, dashboards, and governance scorecards that improve data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and accountability.
* Create and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, governance artifacts, test evidence, and user guidance.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve business processes, data quality, operational efficiency, and the user experience.

**What You Will Need (Required)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in master data management, data governance, data quality, business analysis, or enterprise data operations.
* Practical experience supporting Master Data Management solutions, data stewardship processes, or governed enterprise data domains.
* Experience eliciting, documenting, and validating business requirements and translating them into functional data or application requirements.
* Experience with data profiling, root cause analysis, issue remediation, business rules, data standards, and data quality controls.
* Working proficiency in SQL and experience analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues across connected systems and processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to facilitate discussions across business and technical teams.
* Ability to work independently under general direction, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively across global time zones.
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

* Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud MDM SaaS, Semarchy MDM, or another enterprise multi-domain MDM platform.
* Experience with Healthcare Professional, Supplier, Customer, Product, or other enterprise master data domains.
* Experience supporting an MDM modernization or migration program, including business validation, testing, cutover readiness, and user adoption.
* Experience with Snowflake-based data solutions and integrations among MDM, source applications, and downstream consumers.
* Experience developing data quality dashboards, governance scorecards, stewardship workflows, or operating procedures.
* Relevant industry experience in medical device, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or another regulated environment.

**Additional Information**

* Develops solutions to a variety of complex data management problems and exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques after considering business, data quality, governance, and technical implications.
* Works with general direction focused on end results and may provide guidance to less-experienced team members or data stewards.
* Travel may be required up to 5%.

**Benefits And Equal Opportunity**
Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

title: Marathi Subject Matter Expert – Audio Transcription (AI Training)
description:
**About The Role**
What if your deep command of Marathi and your leadership instincts could directly shape how AI learns to understand spoken language? We're looking for a Subject Matter Expert (SME) based in the Pune–Maharashtra region to lead our Marathi audio transcription project. You'll oversee a team of language labelers and reviewers, provide linguistic guidance, and help ensure consistent, accurate, and high-quality output across the project.
  
  
Pune is home to one of India's most vibrant communities of Marathi speakers and language professionals — making it the ideal location to find the sharp, experienced SME this project demands.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role that rewards sound judgment, clear communication, and a sharp ear for language. You'll guide a team through the natural messiness of real-world audio while keeping quality standards high and the team aligned.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: Hours may vary based on project demands, team needs, and project volume

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and support a team of Marathi-specific labelers and reviewers throughout the project
* Serve as the primary language and project subject matter expert, providing guidance on transcription, labeling, and language-specific questions
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality standards are maintained across all project work
* Monitor team performance and identify recurring quality issues, trends, or areas requiring additional guidance
* Conduct regular audits of labeling and reviewing work and provide actionable feedback
* Manage project-related communications and questions through Discord
* Host Office Hours to answer questions, clarify guidelines, and provide ongoing support to the labeling and reviewing teams
* Help identify ambiguities or gaps in project guidelines and escalate issues when necessary
* Participate in team meetings, calibration sessions, and project discussions
* Support alignment between labelers and reviewers to ensure consistent application of project guidelines
* Communicate important project updates, changes, and quality expectations to the assigned language team
* Collaborate with Project Operators and Project Managers to address quality, workflow, and performance concerns

**Who You Are**

* Native proficiency in Marathi — ideally with strong familiarity with the Pune dialect and surrounding regional variations
* Strong understanding of Marathi grammar, vocabulary, regional or dialectal variation, pronunciation, and natural spoken usage
* Experience with audio transcription, data labeling, linguistic annotation, quality assurance, or AI/ML data projects preferred
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify subtle linguistic, transcription, or labeling errors
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Marathi
* Experience providing feedback, coaching, or leading teams is preferred
* Comfortable working independently and managing multiple project priorities
* Familiarity with Discord or similar online collaboration platforms

**Nice to Have**

* Background in linguistics, language education, journalism, or communications
* Prior experience working on AI or ML data annotation projects
* Awareness of Marathi dialectal differences across Maharashtra — from Nagpuri to Konkan and Vidarbha regions
* Experience with annotation platforms or transcription tools

**Why Join Us**

* Lead a team on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible work
* Shape how AI understands and processes spoken Marathi for millions of people
* Build specialized leadership and quality-assurance skills in AI data pipelines
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer
description:
**Job Posting Title**
Manufacturing Quality Engineer
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
Ensure conformity of the manufacturing processes and correct first time delivery of the product to the customer through the implementation and maintenance of QOS processes, related standards, and best practices.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Maintenance**
Responsible for the implementation and maintenance of quality standards within manufacturing processes. Ensure alignment with the requirements of the Driveline Excellence System.
  
  
**Process Design**
Ensure manufacturing processes and related documentation conforms to specified Process Flow, PFMEA, and Control Plan requirements.
  
  
**Quality Testing**
Develop and initiate methods, procedures, and embedded tests for inspection, testing, and evaluation of manufactured products. Maintain related documentation and records.
  
  
**Quality Testing Design**
Confirm that final inspection/EOL tests prevent non-conforming parts from leaving the plant and coordinate containment and firewall activities.
  
  
**Operational Compliance**
Perform manufacturing process audits to assess quality capability of the processes against established limits and specifications. Provide additional input for process control and initiate a reaction plan for characteristics that are either not statistically capable or are unstable.
  
  
**Quality Management System**
Carry out a range of quality management activities under the guidance of senior colleagues to contribute to the identification and evaluation of current policies and business processes that are in the scope of the quality management system (QMS) and to support the design, development, and documentation of new policies, procedures, and business processes.
  
  
**Improvement/Innovation**
Ensure relevant lessons learned are implemented and countermeasures are horizontally deployed as required.
  
  
**Document Preparation**
Organize and prepare complex documents using a variety of applications for technology devices, such as standard office software. Also responsible for gathering and summarizing data for special reports.
  
  
**Performance Management**
Undertake training when identified to improve business capability and allow for changes in technology and quality requirements. Instigate quality improvements in production area and strive for continuous improvement.
  
  
**Required Skills And Education**
BE (Mech/Auto) with 8 - 10 years of relevant experience
  
  
**About Dauch**
Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries - GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.

The IT Engineer – Agentic AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and continuously optimizing enterprise-grade Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions across global business environments. The role also supports React.js and modern user interface development for AI-enabled applications, establishes AI evaluation criteria and observability standards, and ensures effective human-in-the-loop controls. Responsibilities include troubleshooting hallucinations, integration failures, and model performance issues while supporting Agile and DevOps delivery practices to accelerate enterprise-scale AI transformation initiatives.

Story specification: Translate business objectives, process requirements, and stakeholder expectations into detailed functional and technical designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans for agentic AI and intelligent automation initiatives. Collaborate with business teams, architects, and delivery stakeholders to align AI capabilities with enterprise priorities. Development & delivery: Lead and support the end-to-end delivery of enterprise AI initiatives using Azure-native AI services, orchestration frameworks, APIs, RAG architectures, and modern application technologies. Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, governance, documentation, and coding standards. Develop and review AI workflows, reasoning agents, integrations, React.js user interfaces, and automation components while enforcing testing and deployment conventions. Contribute to solution approvals and production deployment readiness. Testing: Define and execute testing strategies for autonomous systems, reasoning loops, AI safety guardrails, and enterprise integrations. Support functional testing, business acceptance testing, and validation of observability, traceability, and model performance metrics. Verify production readiness and ensure AI solutions meet operational, security, and quality expectations. Incident management: Monitor production AI environments for performance, security, reliability, and compliance issues. Conduct root cause analysis for hallucinations, orchestration failures, integration incidents, and degraded model behavior. Coordinate corrective actions, deploy fixes, improve dashboards and monitoring frameworks, and identify opportunities for automation and process optimization. Project support: Own and contribute to project deliverables in Agile, DevOps, or waterfall delivery models. Collaborate with Project Managers, Scrum Masters, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality delivery of AI solutions. Support planning, estimation, documentation, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement activities.
  
  
**Experience**

* Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Professional experience ranges from 0–1 years for entry-level engineering profiles through 6+ years for advanced engineering and leadership-oriented levels depending on MM1–MM3 maturity classification.
* Strong technical expertise in Python development, AI application engineering, and enterprise integration technologies. Working knowledge of React.js, Node.js, REST APIs, orchestration frameworks, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Agent Service, Semantic Kernel, Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures, vector databases, and cloud-native application development.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, MLOps practices, model monitoring, observability tooling, automated testing, DevOps delivery, and Agile ways of working. Ability to evaluate AI model quality, implement human-in-the-loop controls, troubleshoot hallucinations and reasoning failures, and optimize enterprise AI solutions for performance, security, and scalability.
* Capability expectations differ across MM1–MM3 levels and include progression from supporting development activities and issue resolution to independently leading complex AI engineering initiatives, mentoring engineers, contributing to governance and safety standards, and driving enterprise AI transformation outcomes.

title: Medical Coding Audit Manager
description:
Manages the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Evaluation team supporting Veradigm's enterprise coding capability. The team reviews the outputs of AI agents against clinical documentation to confirm that codes are supported, billable, and accurate, and its judgments establish the clinical ground truth used to measure how our AI agents perform.
  
  
Owns the scoring guide that defines how agent output is judged, incorporating input from the reviewers who apply it. Adjudicates disagreements between reviewers, measures and reports inter-reviewer agreement, and defines the clinical metrics reported to customers, so that accuracy claims made commercially and under federal transparency requirements are defensible. Builds and develops a distributed team of certified coders, plans capacity across specialties, and extends the team's scope across coding, chart preparation, and clinical note quality as the AI roadmap expands.
  
  
**Essential Functions / Major Job Responsibilities**

* Develops and maintains the scoring guide with clinical experts, updating it as specialties and agent behaviors expand.
* Manages daily operations for the review team, including assignments, priorities, capacity, and throughput.
* Adjudicates dual-review disputes, documenting rationale and identifying reviewer error versus guide ambiguity.
* Tracks inter-reviewer agreement, using low agreement to refine guidance rather than penalize staff.
* Runs calibration rounds across reviewers to set throughput benchmarks and validate scaling readiness.
* Reports clinical metrics, accuracy, claims inclusion, and risk impact, to leadership, product teams, and clients.
* Plans specialty coverage, starting with internal medicine and expanding as scope broadens.
* Expands scope into chart prep and note quality, establishing evaluation criteria for subjective tasks.
* Validates automated scoring through sampling and reports divergences between automated and expert review.
* Coordinates design-partner evaluations to maintain consistent review standards across teams.
* Enforces approved data access boundaries, authorized data tiers, and compliant review tools.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent technical or business experience
* 8+ years relevant work experience; 2-3 years at the Expert level or equivalent experience - Preferred
* 4 Years ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding across multiple specialties, with strong attention to detail and a high accuracy rate
* 2 Years coding auditing or coding quality review
* 2 Years outpatient or ambulatory coding in a multi-specialty or large group practice setting
* 1 Year developing coding guidelines, audit criteria, or annotation standards that others apply
* 1 Year reviewing output from automated or computer-assisted coding tools, or other structured annotation work
* Medicare Risk Adjustment or HCC coding experience - preferred
* 2-4 years relevant leadership experience, including leading distributed or remote teams - preferred

Certifications
  
  

* CPC, CCS, or CCS-P - AAPC or AHIMA coding certification, active -Required
* CPMA - Certified Professional Medical Auditor - Preferred
* CRC - Certified Risk Adjustment Coder - Preferred

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Expert-level knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, modifier application, E/M documentation guidelines, and CMS claims processing rules.
* Ability to write clear, unambiguous evaluation criteria that multiple reviewers can apply to reach the same conclusion on the same record.
* Working understanding of measurement concepts relevant to human review, including inter-rater agreement, sampling, and the difference between reviewer error and ambiguous guidance.
* Ability to explain coding reasoning to engineers and product managers who have no coding background, and to translate their technical questions into coding terms.
* Sound judgment in cases where documentation is incomplete or coding guidance does not clearly apply, and the discipline to distinguish confident conclusions from uncertain ones.
* Proven ability to lead others, including where the next-level leader is not in the same location or time zone.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in an environment where standards and processes are still being established.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as they apply to handling clinical information and de-identified data.

**Working Arrangements**

* Standard work week or as defined by assignment requirements.
* Primarily works in a standard office environment or remotely.
* Requires periodic overlap with United States time zones to collaborate with Applied Intelligence, product, and engineering teams.

**Travel**

* Up to 10% travel may be required.

**Benefits**
Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Dimensional Management
description:
**PACCAR India**
is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer - Dimensional Management to drive product development through the effective application of GD&T, 1D/3D tolerance analysis, and variation control methodologies.
  
  
Dimensional Management focuses on delivering high-quality products by understanding, analyzing, and controlling dimensional variation across components and manufacturing processes. In this role, the Dimensional Engineer partners with cross-functional project teams, provides guidance on dimensional management practices, and utilizes advanced engineering tools to evaluate designs, perform tolerance analyses, and recommend solutions that enhance product quality, manufacturability, and performance.
  
  
**At PACCAR**
, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization known for engineering excellence, innovation, and a strong commitment to employee growth and well-being. We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, your contributions make a real difference, and your career can thrive as you help build world-class products that power the future of transportation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**




+ Perform dimensional analysis on assemblies using statistical tolerance stacks and 3-D tolerance analysis software(3DCS).
+ Participate and take initiative in the development of dimensional Design Objectives with styling, design, and manufacturing.
+ Develop Datum scheme and assembly strategies for parts and assemblies that consider input from the design, manufacturing, supplier, and inspection.
+ Apply GD&T per ASME standards to ensure functional and manufacturable designs.
+ Develop and coordinate capability studies and measurement systems; interpret data and provide recommendations.
+ Present analysis results to engineering and management stakeholders.
+ Resolve complex issues using Dimensional Management tools to improve product quality.
+ Promote/teach Dimensional Management tools and processes to multiple project teams.

**Education Requirements**




+ Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Automotive, Electrical or Production Engineering

**Knowledge & Skills REQUIRED**




+ 3+ years of engineering experience with a thorough understanding of Dimensional Management, preferably in the automotive and/or trucking industry, Heavy Industries.
+ In-depth understanding and practical application of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) principles.
+ Proficient in 3D tolerance analysis using 3DCS, with experience in evaluating and optimizing assembly variation.
+ Experience in Excel-based 1D tolerance stack-up analysis for design validation and problem-solving.
+ Good understanding of automotive components, assemblies, and dimensional requirements across vehicle systems.
+ Strong grasp of statistical methods for analyzing, predicting, and controlling dimensional variation in engineering designs.
+ Ability to manage multiple tasks, takes initiative, and work collaboratively as a team player and problem solver.
+ Effective communication and coordination skills with cross-functional teams.

**Knowledge & Skills DESIRED**




+ Creo skills – an added advantage.
+ GD&T certifications
+ Desired certification in DFSS and/or Six Sigma Belt programs
+ Experience with CMM and portable inspection devices and reports -desired
+ Experience desired in measurement systems analysis, Statistical Process Control, Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) desired.
+ Detailed understanding of manufacturing processes, production assembly fixtures, and inspection equipment desired.
+ Teaching/coaching experience with a technical topic desired.

**Competencies And Behaviours**




+ Problem‑solving skills with learning approach
+ Proactive, self-driven, and takes initiative
+ Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
+ Team player with highly effective interpersonal and collaboration skills
+ Work with Integrity, Ownership & Accountability
+ Attention to detail and quality-focused mindset

We are seeking an experienced Application Operations professional to provide hands-on ownership of Oracle Order and Service Management (OSM), Oracle Unified Inventory Management (UIM), and associated telecom fulfilment services. Based in Pune, this role is focused on ensuring service stability, SLA/KPI achievement, technical troubleshooting, order fulfilment continuity, inventory integrity, operational governance, automation, and continual service improvement. * Collaborate with infrastructure, middleware, database, provisioning, networking, service management, and vendor teams

* Ensure compliance with approved change, security, audit, access, and governance requirements

* Extensive experience in telecom OSS and Application Operations environments with strong exposure to Oracle OSM and/or Oracle UIM
* Hands-on experience managing order orchestration, order fallout, service fulfilment, provisioning, and inventory management issues within production environments
* Strong working knowledge of Oracle OSM order lifecycle, workflows, decomposition, recovery, and exception handling

title: Test Strategy & Operations Lead for Regression Testing - S/4E Program
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
This role is being created as an addition to the ERP Competence Centre to address the increased quantity and complexity of testing requirements driven by the S4E program rollout. You will be critical in establishing a robust testing framework for a multi-year, dynamic project phase, with a focus on developing and governing the overall test strategy for Regression (REG) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), overseeing the operational management of all related testing activities, and managing the phased transition of these services to the permanent AMS/Operations team. As an expert-level professional, you will bring extensive experience in large-scale ERP test management, particularly within SAP environments, with a proven ability to define complex test strategies, manage vendor-led execution, and lead service transition initiatives.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* 40% Test Strategy & Governance

+ Develop, implement, and own the end-to-end test strategy for Regression (REG) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) across the S4E program.
+ Define and establish standards, processes, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for test execution, defect management, and quality reporting.
+ Determine testing scope, entry/exit criteria, and quality gates for various S4E project rollout phases.
+ Collaborate with solution architects and functional teams to ensure test scenarios provide comprehensive coverage of critical business processes and technical specifications.

* 40% Test Operations & Execution Management

+ Oversee the planning and execution of all REG and NFR test cycles, coordinating activities between internal teams and the external AMS partner.
+ Manage the provisioning and maintenance of required test environments, test data, and testing tools for the S4E program.
+ Monitor test progress, analyze results for trends and risks, and provide regular, clear status reports to program leadership and key stakeholders.
+ Lead the triage and root cause analysis of critical defects and performance bottlenecks, driving resolution with development and infrastructure teams.

* 20% Service Transition & Stakeholder Management

+ Design and execute a phased transition plan to hand over established testing services from the S4E project to the long-term SAP Operations/AMS team.

title: Software QA Engineer - Physics AI
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge Simcenter™ portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing.
  
  
We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities.
  
  
In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results.
  
  
This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results.
* Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities.
* Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases.
* Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate.
* Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution.
* Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities.
* Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment.

**Qualifications**

* 4–6+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation.
* 1–3+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products.
* Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness.
* Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI-driven predictions against physics-based, simulation, or solver-generated reference results.
* Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post-processing tools is highly valuable.
* Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI-enabled engineering applications.
* Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data.
* Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross-platform desktop software testing.
* Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks.
* Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system-level testing.
* Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. title: Agency Support Quality Analyst
description:
Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2,200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.
  
  
The Agency Support Quality Analyst plays a vital role in upholding the accuracy, efficiency, and compliance standards of our Renter’s Insurance Verification operations. While maintaining a reduced volume of direct document processing, this role primarily focuses on performing quality assurance (QA) audits on insurance verification reviews completed by the broader India-based team. Beyond auditing, the Quality Analyst acts as an operational coach—analyzing trend data, delivering constructive feedback, identifying knowledge gaps, and leading ongoing training initiatives to ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Quality Assurance Auditing: Conduct regular, structured QA audits on resident Proof of Insurance (POI) evaluations, policy updates, cancellations, and reinstatements processed by the verification team
* Coaching & Feedback: Provide clear, actionable, and constructive feedback to team members on audit findings to correct errors, reinforce standards, and encourage performance improvements.
* Training & Onboarding: Lead training sessions for new hires and conduct refresher training for existing staff on updated SOPs, complex policy rules, and edge-case document processing.
* Root Cause & Trend Analysis: Analyze error patterns and audit data to identify recurring operational bottlenecks or training gaps; present actionable insights to team leads and the US-based Supervisor.
* Production Support (Reduced Volume): Maintain hands-on expertise by processing a reduced quota of active document verification cases, ensuring continuous alignment with day-to-day queue workflows.
* SOP Maintenance: Partner with leadership to create, update, and refine SOP documentation, training guides, and audit rubric materials as policy or system requirements evolve.

**Essential Functions**

* Systematically review processed records against community coverage standards with high detail and consistency
* Translate complex quality data and error trends into clear coaching points and structured learning modules
* Maintain an objective, supportive, and collaborative approach when delivering performance feedback to peers across shifts
* Flexibly manage time between active processing queues, daily audit quotas, and interactive coaching sessions.
* Effectively communicate audit findings, trend updates, and operational risks to US-based leadership.
* Ability to prioritize tasks effectively by meeting deadlines and managing workload efficiently.
* Maintain professional interaction with internal and external stakeholders
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-stress environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* English Proficiency: High-level English language proficiency—both written and verbal—with superior comprehension and communication skills for leading training sessions and providing feedback.
* Relevant Experience: 3+ years of total experience in back-office operations, document verification, or insurance operations, with at least 1+ years in a dedicated Quality Analyst, Peer Coach, or Senior SME role.
* Insurance Knowledge: Strong understanding of Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance documents (declaration pages, COIs) and renter's insurance concepts.
* Analytical & Reporting Skills: Proven ability to analyze audit data, track metrics in spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets), and identify workflow trends.
* Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk), and standard productivity suites.
* Typically requires a minimum of 2 - 4 years of related experience in customer service, quality assurance, or insurance support.
* High School Diploma or equivalent required; some college coursework in business or a related field preferred.

**AI & Operational Fluency**

* AI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables
* Strategic Oversight: Exercise critical judgment as the "Human-in-the-Loop," by auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations.
* Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models.
* Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains.

Entrata is dedicated to creating a workplace where a diverse and inclusive team thrives in an environment free from discrimination. We provide equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.
  
  
It’s a great place to work! Will you join us?
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Test / Integration Engineer II
description:
Job Title
  
  
Test / Integration Engineer II
  
  
**Job Description**
**Test Integration Engineer II | Pune, India | Full-time**
If you are experienced in system integration, testing, and troubleshooting of complex
  
  
automation systems, this is an opportunity to take ownership of testing activities and
  
  
contribute to the successful delivery of Vanderlande’s projects worldwide.
  
  
**Your Role**
As a Test Integration Engineer II, you will independently execute and coordinate testing
  
  
activities across subsystems and project phases. You will work closely with engineering
  
  
disciplines, project teams, and customers to ensure systems are thoroughly tested and
  
  
meet defined requirements.
  
  
You will also contribute to improving testing practices, reviewing test artefacts,
  
  
investigating defects, and supporting the development of junior Test Integration
  
  
Engineers.
  
  
**What You Will Do / Key Responsibilities**
Testing & Integration
  
  

* Independently plan and execute integration, system, and acceptance testing

activities.
  
  

* Lead testing activities for assigned subsystems and functional areas.
* Prepare and execute test cases based on system requirements, system designs,

and approved test plans.
  
  

* Support FAT, SAT, and other customer acceptance activities.
* Analyse and evaluate test results and identify deviations or defects.
* Verify implemented solutions and confirm successful resolution of identified

defects.
  
  

* Review and approve test cases, test procedures, and other relevant test

artefacts.
  
  

* Ensure testing activities are performed according to project and engineering

standards.
  
  
Defect Investigation & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Drive investigation of defects identified during testing.
* Perform detailed analysis of system behaviour, logs, and test results.
* Coordinate with software, controls, electrical, and other engineering teams to

resolve technical issues.
  
  

* Verify corrective actions and ensure defects are properly closed.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to preventive actions and process

improvements.
  
  
Team & Stakeholder Coordination
  
  

* Coach and support junior Test Integration Engineers.
* Coordinate testing activities with multidisciplinary project teams.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, issues, and results to project stakeholders.
* Support customer discussions related to testing and system acceptance.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing methods, tools, and

processes.
  
  
**What You Bring**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical, E&TC, or Computer

Engineering.
  
  

* 4–6 years of relevant experience in software testing, system testing, integration

testing, or a related engineering environment.
  
  

* Strong understanding of software testing and development life cycles, including

V-Model, CMMI, Agile, and test processes.
  
  

* Hands-on experience with Polarion, Jira, Oracle PL/SQL, and Unix.
* Experience in preparing and reviewing test cases, test plans, integration plans,

and system design documentation.
  
  

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently execute testing activities and coordinate with multiple

engineering disciplines.
  
  

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience mentoring or supporting junior engineers is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively based on business requirements and on short

notice.
  
  

* Knowledge of PLC, SCADA, airport baggage handling, material handling, or

distribution systems is an advantage.
  
  
**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort
  
  
parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the
  
  
complete bag journey—from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim
  
  
belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to
  
  
customers’ doors.
  
  
At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that
  
  
matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Website**
www.vanderlande.com

the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice

* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
* 22 paid leave days
* 8 sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays

* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development

description:

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere’s AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments.
  
  
The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework.
* Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments.
* Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations.
* Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting.
* Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure.
* Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting.
* Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence.

title: Quality Specialist - Pune, India
description:
At Q4, we make an impact together, obsess over our customers, operate with integrity, and bring big ideas to life.
   

  

 Q4 is charting a bold new path for investor relations as the first AI\-driven IR Ops Platform, providing everything an IR team needs to succeed on a single, powerful platform. The Q4 Platform enables public companies to attract, manage, and understand investors \- all in one place. Over 2,600 customers, including many of the most respected brands in the world, trust Q4 to help drive premium valuations for their companies. Only Q4 offers a tech stack holistically designed to equip IR teams with data, insights, and smart workflows that power remarkable outcomes. Learn more at q4inc.com.
   

  

 We hire smart, curious, and talented people to push boundaries, reimagine what’s possible, and turn challenges into opportunities. All while keeping the needs of our clients at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

****Come grow with us!****
****The Role: Quality Specialist****
 As a Quality Specialist, you will help ensure the quality of our products by supporting a shift\-left approach to development, while actively leveraging AI to multiply your impact. You will work closely with Dev and Product to apply quality engineering practices across the full development cycle: planning, test design, automation, and production monitoring. You are expected to use AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow, for generating and evaluating test cases, accelerating automation development, exploring edge cases, and analyzing quality signals, not as an occasional convenience.
   

  

 You bring both strong QA/QE fundamentals and agentic, AI\-forward skills that make you significantly more effective than a traditional QA engineer.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Quality Engineering Support:
* 
+ Apply and follow quality engineering practices throughout the development cycle.
+ Support the maturation of the Product in alignment with other Product line developments in the R\&D group.

* Testing Approach Execution:
* 
+ Design and execute effective and efficient test cases, ensuring strong coverage throughout product development.
+ Collaborate with Product and Dev to support quality strategy and sprint\-level planning.

* Automation Contribution:
* 
+ Build and maintain test automation scripts across relevant layers of the development cycle.
+ Contribute to the implementation and adoption of a BDD development model.

* Real\-world Usage Testing:
* 
+ Explore and test real\-world usage scenarios of the product to identify quality risks during POC and development.
+ Support the maintenance and enhancement of the QA automation framework integrated into a CI/CD model.

* Quality Control Support:
* 
+ Support quality control activities for software deliverables, up to and including client handover.
+ Promote quality assurance standards, culture, and best practices within the team.

* Documentation:
* 
+ Maintain accurate documentation of quality assurance artifacts.

* Team Collaboration:
* 
+ Serve as an active QA contributor at the squad level.
+ Participate in regular sync\-ups with the team and share knowledge with peers.


****AI \& Agentic System Testing****
* Build test harnesses for LLM\-backed and agentic features — prompts, chains, tool\-use, multi\-agent flows
* Define and implement AI\-specific quality signals: hallucination rate, instruction fidelity, context leakage, output consistency
* Design exploratory AI agents and LLM\-as\-judge patterns to scale coverage beyond what scripted suites can reach
* Test non\-deterministic systems deliberately: statistical assertions, behavioral envelopes, adversarial inputs


****Agentic Test Orchestration****
* Build and operate AI\-powered test planning and orchestration workflows — use agents to explore product surfaces, generate test conditions, and prioritize risk dynamically
* Design LLM\-as\-judge patterns and autonomous exploratory agents to scale coverage beyond scripted suites
* Partner with Dev to define quality gates in CI/CD — you set the coverage contracts; Dev implements the automation
* Drive test observability: coverage trends, flake rates, regression velocity, release readiness signals


**Additional Tasks**
* Participate in all relevant sprint rituals.
* Maintain test suites and relevant documentation for the Product.
