title: SAP S/4HANA Automation Tester
description:
Established in 2011 and headquartered in Pune, METRO Global Solution Center (GSC) India is a strategic hub driving METRO’s global transformation. With 1,200\+ professionals, we deliver specialized integrated expertise across Master Data Management, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Marketing \& Design, Strategy, Finance \& Accounting, controlling (FP\&A), and People \& Culture (HR) solutions that drive operational excellence and digital innovation.
   

  





 By supporting METRO’s sCore strategy, we enable sustainable growth and strengthen business processes. With a solutions\-first mindset, we reduce complexity, accelerate transformation, and create measurable value for METRO businesses scaling up globally. METRO is a leading international food wholesaler operating in over 30 countries with a strong network of wholesale stores, digital marketplaces, and food service distribution. It supports businesses that keep the world running, from hotels, restaurants, and cafés to local retailers \- offering quality, reliability, and smart solutions that help small and medium\-sized businesses succeed.
   

  





 Headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany, METRO AG employs over 85,000 people worldwide and acts as the central management holding company of the group, driving strategic direction, and enabling consistent excellence across all markets. Around the world, METRO has approx. 15 million customers who benefit from the wholesale company’s unique multichannel mix: customers can purchase their goods in one of the large stores in their area as well as by delivery (Food Service Distribution, FSD) – all digitally supported and connected. In parallel, METRO MARKETS is being developed as an international online marketplace for professional customers, which has been growing and expanding continuously since 2019\.
   

  





 Acting sustainably is one of the company principles of METRO, which has been listed in various sustainability indices and rankings, including MSCI, Sustainalytics and CDP.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Your responsibilities**




**Test planning and governance**



* Apply and continuously improve the LUCA end\-to\-end test strategy across assigned releases and rollout waves, covering unit support, system integration, end\-to\-end, regression, user acceptance and cutover\-related validation.
* Develop integrated test plans that define scope, cycles, milestones, entry and exit criteria, environments, test data, responsibilities, dependencies and required evidence.
* Establish and operate consistent quality gates, governance routines, escalation paths, status reporting and readiness assessments in alignment with the overall LUCA Test Management team.
* Maintain transparent traceability from business requirements and process designs to test cases, executions, defects and acceptance evidence.
* Coordinate testing dependencies across LUCA process streams, SAP and non\-SAP partner systems, migration activities, environments, interfaces and country organisations.



**Test design, execution and defect management**



* Work with Process Leads, Process Owners, solution architects, country teams and implementation partners to translate SAP Finance and SAP Ariba requirements into robust, prioritised end\-to\-end test scenarios.
* Challenge test scope and coverage from a business\-process, control, integration and data perspective, ensuring that critical and high\-risk scenarios are adequately represented.
* Coordinate test preparation and execution across distributed teams, including tester onboarding, script readiness, test\-data availability, environment readiness, daily progress monitoring and evidence quality.
* Lead defect\-management routines, ensure complete and consistent defect documentation, facilitate triage and prioritisation, and drive critical issues to timely resolution and retest.
* Provide concise reporting on execution progress, coverage, defect trends, blockers, residual risks and recommendations for test completion and go\-live readiness.



**System Integrator delivery management**



* Define, agree and govern the SI test deliverables, responsibilities, milestones, quality expectations and acceptance criteria for each test phase and rollout wave.
* Hold the SI accountable for timely and complete preparation of test plans, test scenarios, scripts, test data requirements, execution evidence, defect analysis, status reporting and closure documentation within its scope.
* Review and challenge SI estimates, resource plans, test coverage and execution progress, ensuring that delivery commitments are realistic, transparent and aligned with LUCA milestones.
* Operate regular SI performance and delivery reviews focused on agreed outcomes, overdue actions, blockers, defect ageing, retest readiness and remediation plans.
* Ensure that SI\-led testing is coordinated with METRO business teams, LUCA functional and technical teams, partner\-system owners and country organisations, with clear handovers and no gaps in accountability.
* Escalate material SI delivery risks early, supported by evidence and a clear assessment of their impact on quality gates, UAT readiness and go\-live decisions.



**User Acceptance Testing management**



* Own the end\-to\-end planning and management of the UAT exercise for assigned LUCA rollout waves, in close alignment with the overall LUCA Test Management team and country business leadership.
* Define the UAT scope, approach, schedule, entry and exit criteria, business\-process coverage, tester organisation, environments, roles, authorisations, test data, evidence standards and sign\-off process.
* Coordinate the nomination, onboarding and readiness of business testers and key users, ensuring that responsibilities, availability, scripts, data, tools and escalation channels are understood before execution starts.
* Ensure the SI and LUCA teams provide a stable, sufficiently tested solution for UAT, including completed prerequisite testing, resolved blocking defects, available interfaces and documented known limitations.
* Lead UAT execution governance through daily progress reviews, issue triage, defect prioritisation, retest coordination, coverage monitoring and transparent reporting to programme and country stakeholders.
* Drive formal UAT completion and business acceptance by consolidating results, open defects, workarounds, residual risks and sign\-off evidence, without substituting for the accountable business approvers.



**Tools and test automation**



* Use Zephyr within the agreed Jira\-based testing approach to support structured test\-case management, test cycles, execution tracking, traceability, reporting and audit evidence.
* Help establish reusable test assets and consistent naming, status and evidence standards across LUCA rollout waves.
* Contribute to the LUCA test\-automation strategy and identify suitable regression and end\-to\-end scenarios for automation based on risk, repeatability, stability and business value.
* Coordinate UiPath\-based SAP test\-automation activities with functional teams and automation specialists, including prioritisation, test\-data needs, execution scheduling, result review and maintenance requirements.
* Promote the reuse of automated tests across SAP GUI, SAP Fiori and connected business processes where this is supported by the agreed LUCA toolchain.



**Stakeholder and delivery management**



* Coordinate virtual and cross\-functional testing teams across, LUCA central teams, country organisations and implementation partners.
* Facilitate test\-planning, execution, defect and readiness forums with a clear focus on decisions, ownership, delivery commitments and unresolved risks.
* Escalate quality risks early and communicate their business, process, technology and schedule impacts to the appropriate programme stakeholders.
* Support business readiness and UAT by ensuring that testers understand their responsibilities, scripts, test data, evidence expectations and issue\-reporting process.
* Capture lessons learned and improve test methods, templates, reporting and automation practices across successive rollout waves.


**Qualifications**

**Experience and knowledge**



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance or a related discipline.
* **At least 10 years of experience** 
 in SAP testing or quality management, including substantial responsibility as a Test Manager in complex multinational SAP transformation programmes.
* Practical experience across the full testing lifecycle and with waterfall, agile or hybrid delivery approaches.
* Strong knowledge of SAP Finance processes and integration points, with the ability to evaluate end\-to\-end scenarios across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Controlling and connected systems.
* Good knowledge of SAP Ariba and procurement\-to\-pay integration, including the ability to understand business scenarios spanning procurement, invoicing and Finance.
* Experience testing interface\-heavy landscapes, data migration, cross\-system business processes and third\-party applications.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Jira and Zephyr, including test\-case organisation, execution tracking, traceability and reporting.
* Knowledge of UiPath for SAP test automation is highly advantageous, particularly for regression testing and connected end\-to\-end processes.
* Proven experience managing System Integrator test\-delivery commitments and coordinating internal teams, business testers and implementation vendors across geographies without relying solely on direct authority.
* Demonstrated experience planning and leading large\-scale UAT exercises, including business\-tester mobilisation, readiness management, daily execution governance, defect triage, acceptance evidence and sign\-off coordination.
* SAP, ISTQB, test\-management or UiPath certification is advantageous but not required; retail\-industry experience is beneficial.



**Ways of working**



* Strong analytical and risk\-based mindset, with the ability to distinguish critical quality issues from lower\-priority findings and explain the rationale clearly.
* Highly structured and dependable approach to planning, governance, documentation, follow\-up and escalation.
* Clear and articulate communication with business, functional and technical stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
* Confident facilitation skills and the ability to challenge constructively, secure commitments and drive cross\-team topics to closure.
* Calm and pragmatic behaviour under delivery pressure, combined with a high level of ownership and attention to evidence and detail.
* Excellent written and spoken English; willingness and ability to travel when required.


**Additional Information**

**Measures of success**



* Test scope, plans, responsibilities, dependencies and quality gates are agreed early and remain aligned with LUCA milestones.
* Requirements and critical business processes have transparent, evidence\-based test coverage across SAP Finance, SAP Ariba and connected systems.
* Test cycles start with appropriate script, data, environment and resource readiness, reducing avoidable execution delays.
* Defects are documented consistently, prioritised appropriately and resolved or accepted with transparent residual risk.
* Stakeholders receive reliable reporting and recommendations to support test completion and go\-live decisions.
* Reusable manual and automated regression assets improve quality and efficiency across successive LUCA rollout waves.
* The SI delivers agreed test assets and services on time and at the required quality, with transparent remediation where commitments are at risk.
* UAT is appropriately prepared, actively governed and concluded with clear business acceptance evidence and transparent residual risk.
* Test governance and delivery from METRO Digital India are fully integrated with the overall LUCA Test Management team.

title: Quality engineer Fabrication and machining
description:
Job Description – Quality Engineer (Machining \& Fabrication)
   

 Company: WTEC Energy India Pvt. Ltd.
   

 Department: Quality
   

 Position: Quality Engineer – Machining \& Fabrication
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Travel Requirement: Approximately 70% Domestic \& International Travel / 30% Office\-Based
   

 Experience: Minimum 3 Years
   

 Education: B.E. / B.Tech. – Mechanical Engineering
   

  

 Position Summary
   

 WTEC Energy India Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a Quality Engineer with a strong background in machining and fabrication quality. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality of machined and fabricated components through inspection, supplier/site visits, documentation, quality control, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
   

 The position requires extensive travel to supplier and project locations within India and internationally. Experience with electrical products/components will be considered an added advantage.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

 Quality Inspection \& Control
   

 • Perform inspection of machined and fabricated components as per engineering drawings, specifications, approved procedures, and applicable quality standards.
   

 • Conduct incoming, in\-process, pre\-dispatch, and final inspections at supplier location as required.
   

 • Verify dimensional accuracy, tolerances, surface finish, welding/fabrication quality, and overall workmanship.
   

 • Support supplier quality improvement and continuous improvement activities.
   

 • Ensure components conform to approved drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
   

 • Identify and document non\-conformities (NCRs) and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.
   

 • Participate in root cause analysis and follow up on corrective actions with suppliers and concerned departments.
   

  

 Measuring Instruments \& Technical Knowledge
   

 • Possess in\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with measuring and inspection instruments such as:
   

 o Vernier Caliper
   

 o Micrometer
   

 o Height Gauge
   

 o Bore Gauge
   

 o Dial Indicator
   

 o Depth Gauge
   

 o Thread Gauges
   

 o Surface Roughness Tester
   

 o Other dimensional inspection equipment
   

 • Understand GD\&T, engineering drawings, tolerances, fits, surface finish, and machining symbols.
   

 • Ensure measuring instruments used for inspection are within valid calibration and maintain traceability of inspection equipment.
   

  

 Machining \& Fabrication Quality
   

 • Good understanding of machining processes such as turning, milling, drilling, grinding, boring, and CNC machining.
   

 • Knowledge of fabrication processes including cutting, bending, welding, fit\-up, assembly, and finishing.
   

 • Inspect fabricated structures/components for dimensional conformity and workmanship.
   

 • Knowledge of welding inspection, welding defects, WPS/PQR and NDT processes will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Supplier \& Site Quality
   

 • Visit suppliers/vendors for inspection, quality verification, process audits, and pre\-dispatch inspection.
   

 • Coordinate with suppliers for resolution of quality issues and implementation of corrective actions.
   

 • Review supplier inspection reports, material certificates, calibration records, and other quality documents.
   

 • Support supplier development and supplier quality performance improvement.
   

 • Prepare visit/inspection reports and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
   

  

 Documentation
   

 • Prepare and maintain quality documentation, including:
   

 o Inspection Reports
   

 o Dimensional Inspection Reports
   

 o NCR Reports
   

 o Corrective Action Reports
   

 o Supplier Quality Reports
   

 o Material/Test Certificates
   

 o Calibration Records
   

 o Inspection Checklists
   

 o Quality and Site Visit Reports
   

 • Maintain proper records and traceability of quality documents.
   

 • Support preparation and review of quality documentation required by customers and projects.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

 • Work closely with Engineering, Design, Procurement, Sourcing, Projects, Production, Suppliers, and Management.
   

 • Coordinate with the engineering/design team for clarification of drawings, tolerances, and technical requirements.
   

 • Support procurement and sourcing teams in supplier quality evaluation.
   

 • Communicate quality issues clearly and ensure timely closure of identified concerns.
   

 Qualification \& Experience
   

 • B.E. / B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering.
   

 • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a Machining and/or Fabrication Quality Department.
   

 • Strong practical knowledge of dimensional inspection and measuring instruments.
   

 • Good understanding of engineering drawings, GD\&T, machining processes, fabrication processes, and quality documentation.
   

 • Experience in supplier quality, vendor inspection, or supplier development will be preferred.
   

 • Experience or exposure to electrical equipment/components will be an added advantage.
   

 • Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and other documentation tools.
   

 Travel Requirements
   

 • Candidate should be willing to travel approximately 70% of the time, including domestic and international supplier/project visits.
   

 • Approximately 30% of the role will involve office\-based activities, including documentation, reporting, coordination, and quality follow\-up.
   

 • Flexibility to travel at short notice based on project and inspection requirements.
   

 • Valid passport will be an added advantage.
   

 Key Skills
   

 • Machining \& Fabrication Quality
   

 • Supplier/Site Inspection
   

 • Measuring Instruments
   

 • Engineering Drawing Interpretation
   

 • Supplier Quality Management
   

 • Quality Documentation
   

 • NCR \& Corrective Action Management
   

 • Root Cause Analysis
   

 • Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

 • Problem Solving
   

 • Technical Reporting
   

 • Communication Skills
   

 • GD\&T

 If you are an Electronics Manufacturing Test Engineer looking for a great opportunity to grow, develop and expand your skills professionally, Emerson has an exciting must\-see opportunity for you based in our Pune location. As a Test Engineer, you will be a part of a team responsible for new product development of industrial automation products \& bring new technology into the industrial space.
   

  

**In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will:**
* Work as part of a multi\-discipline team.
* Develop automated test systems using LabVIEW, Test Stand.
* Collaborate with other team members to interpret schematics and integrate test solutions.
* Understand circuit design and modifications to support test setups.
* Troubleshoot and debug test systems to ensure reliability and accuracy.
* Document test procedures, results, and system configurations for compliance and knowledge sharing.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives in test automation and hardware validation.
* Collaborate with multi\-functional teams to ensure overall system requirements are fulfilled with a cost\-effective and high\-quality approach.
* Develop and execute electronics test plans for verification and validation.

 You are a hands\-on, technically focused engineer who confidently develops and actualizes Test setups. * Good working knowledge of electronic test equipment including scopes, meters, signal generators, etc.
* 5\+ years of experience with Basic analog, digital circuit and industrial communication protocols (e.g., HART, SPI, UART and ethernet).
* Strong proficiency in LabVIEW and Test Stand.
* Solid C\# programming skills for application and tool development.
* Basic knowledge of schematic reading to understand hardware designs.
* Basic Layout design understanding.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills in both hardware and software domains.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate across disciplines.
* Experience working in a global engineering environment.
* Experience in developing hardware for product that involves pneumatic actuators control valve interface will be an added advantage.
* Strong exposure to Life cycle Management of products.

title: Digital-Quantum - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Position Name FIS Quantum Implementation Specialist \- Senior**
**Position Details**
**Program Leadership \& Client Advisory**
* Lead or co lead multi workstream Quantum implementations—from scope \& design through build, test, go live and stabilization—serving as the day to day advisor to Treasury, Finance, and IT stakeholders.
* Translate complex treasury requirements (FX, MM, IRD, commodities, cash pooling/IHB, netting, payments, hedge accounting) into scalable Quantum designs and roadmaps.
* Run solution design workshops; produce blueprints, specifications, data models and test strategies; manage risks, issues, and CCB.


**Configuration \& Build**
* Configure core Quantum modules (Deal Capture, Cash/Liquidity, Payments, Confirmations, Accounting, Risk, Reporting) and workflow (EWF), including controls and auditability.
* Design/optimize interfaces with ERPs (SAP/Oracle), bank connectivity, market data, and downstream reporting (BI/DWH).
* Create/optimize SQL, reports, and customizations as needed; contribute to performance tuning and environment readiness.


**Testing, Cutover \& Hypercare**
* Own SIT/UAT planning and execution; write test plans/cases; coordinate defect triage; orchestrate cutover run books and post go live support.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls and SOX requirements in design, testing, and change management.


**Optimization \& Health Checks**
* Assess existing Quantum estates to identify quick wins, release adoption and medium term enhancements (APIs, oData, EWF, dashboards, data lakes/BI, AI adjacent use cases).


**People \& Practice**
* Mentor junior consultants; contribute to accelerators, templates and best practices; support pre sales (demos, effort estimates).


**Qualifications**
**Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)**
* A bachelor’s degree (BE/BTech/MCA \& MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.


**Technical skills requirements:**
* 5–8\+ years in TMS delivery with hands on FIS Quantum across at least two full lifecycle implementations.
* Strong treasury domain: cash \& liquidity, IHB/pooling, payments \& connectivity, FX/IR/commodity risk, hedge accounting, accounting integration.
* Tech depth: SQL and data model familiarity; integration patterns with ERPs/banks/MDPs; Quantum EWF, interfaces, custom reports.
* Proven client facing consulting skills (workshops, requirements, solution options, stakeholder mgmt. up to CFO/Treasurer).
* Willingness to travel 25–50% based on project needs.


**Additional skills requirements:**
* The expectations are that a Senior will be able to maintain long\-term client relationships and network and cultivate business development opportunities
* Provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing engagement manager of engagement status, and managing staff performance.
* Must have presentation skills ' ability to create PowerPoint deck to communicate solution architecture to various stakeholders.
* Should have understanding and experience of L1 and L2 Support.
* Excellent business communication, Consulting, Quality process skills
* Must be a team player


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Systems Integration Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 
 387527
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Advisor to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN\-MH), India (IN).
   

  

**Job Title: Microsoft Full Stack Developer (Mid\-Level)**
**Company:** 
 NTT DATA Services
   

  

**Location / Work Model:** 
 Pune/ Hybrid]
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Experience range:** 
 5\- 10 years
   

  

**Role Summary**
 NTT DATA Services is seeking a skilled
 **Microsoft Full Stack Developer** 
 to design, build, deploy, and support secure, scalable
 **web applications** 
 across the Microsoft and Azure ecosystem. This role will contribute across the full software delivery lifecycle—from translating product requirements into technical solutions through development, automated testing, cloud deployment, production monitoring, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will develop modern backend services using C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, and SQL\-based data platforms, alongside responsive frontend experiences using \[Angular / React / Blazor / preferred framework]. The role also offers the opportunity to integrate practical AI\-enabled capabilities, such as Azure OpenAI Service or Azure AI services, into business applications in a secure, responsible, and maintainable manner.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and maintain full stack applications using C\#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and \[Angular / React / Blazor / preferred framework].
* Build secure, well\-documented, and performant RESTful APIs that support web applications, integrations, and internal or external consumers.
* Develop responsive and accessible user interfaces using JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend engineering practices.
* Design and implement cloud\-native application components on Microsoft Azure, using services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, and Azure Service Bus where appropriate.
* Implement data access and persistence layers using SQL Server or Azure SQL Database and Entity Framework Core, with attention to reliability, performance, and data integrity.
* Integrate AI\-enabled application features using relevant Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI Service, LLM APIs, semantic search, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns under architectural guidance.
* Apply secure coding practices, including secrets management through Azure Key Vault, authentication and authorization controls, input validation, dependency management, and secure API design.
* Build and maintain automated unit, integration, and API tests; identify defects early and improve overall test coverage and software reliability.
* Configure and support CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Git\-based workflows to enable consistent, repeatable, and controlled deployments.
* Monitor application health, reliability, and performance using tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor; investigate issues and support production incident resolution.
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives within an Agile delivery team.
* Collaborate with product managers, UX/UI designers, QA engineers, architects, and fellow developers to deliver maintainable solutions that meet functional and non\-functional requirements.


**Required Qualifications**
* Technical Skills
* Strong hands\-on experience developing backend applications using C\#, .NET / .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, including API security, versioning, error handling, and documentation.
* Practical frontend development experience with \[Angular / React / Blazor / preferred framework], JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Experience with relational databases, including SQL Server and/or Azure SQL Database, database design, SQL querying, and performance considerations.
* Familiarity with data access technologies such as Entity Framework Core.
* Practical experience deploying or supporting applications on Azure, including relevant services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure DevOps, Application Insights, and Azure Monitor.
* Understanding of asynchronous or event\-driven integration patterns; experience with Azure Service Bus or similar messaging technologies is beneficial.
* Practical experience, or a strong working understanding, of integrating AI capabilities into applications through Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI Service, generative AI APIs, LLM APIs, semantic search, or RAG patterns.
* Engineering Practices
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming, SOLID principles, clean architecture, separation of concerns, and common design patterns.
* Experience with Git\-based source control, pull requests, code reviews, branching strategies, and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, including unit tests and integration tests.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices and deployment automation using Azure DevOps or comparable tooling.
* Understanding performance optimization, logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and observability practices.
* Knowledge of secure coding principles, including secure configuration, secrets management, dependency security, and API protection.
* Ability to produce clean, maintainable, readable, and appropriately documented code.
* Professional Skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams in an Agile or iterative delivery environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a practical approach to balancing quality, delivery timelines, and technical risk.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ownership mindset and willingness to support applications through development, deployment, and production operations.
* Ability to learn new technologies and apply them thoughtfully to business needs.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Microsoft Azure certifications, such as Azure Developer Associate, Azure Fundamentals, or other relevant Azure credentials.
* Experience with Azure API Management, Azure Service Bus, containerization, Kubernetes, microservices, or distributed system design.
* Hands\-on experience implementing advanced AI/ML or generative AI solutions, including prompt engineering, vector databases, semantic search, RAG evaluation, model safety controls, or responsible AI practices.
* Experience with identity and access management technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, or automated environment provisioning.
* Experience in \[relevant industry or product domain, if applicable].
* Experience mentoring junior developers, leading technical workstreams, or contributing to solution architecture and technical standards.
* What Success Looks Like in the First 6–12 Months
* Delivers production\-ready full stack features that meet agreed functional, security, performance, and quality requirements.
* Establishes a strong understanding of the application architecture, deployment processes, development standards, and product priorities.
* Contributes reliable .NET APIs, frontend components, database changes, and Azure services that integrate effectively with the wider platform.
* Improves code quality through meaningful code reviews, automated testing, refactoring, documentation, and adherence to engineering standards.
* Supports stable deployments through effective use of CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, logging, and timely production issue investigation.
* Delivers or contributes to at least one practical AI\-enabled feature or integration that is aligned with business needs, technical architecture, security expectations, and responsible AI principles.

 Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
   

  

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery\-side credibility
* Platform\-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: SAP Concur-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SAP Concur Senior Consultant**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities:**
 EY GDS is seeking an experienced SAP Concur Senior Consultant with strong functional and technical expertise in SAP Concur solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands on experience in end to end implementations, advanced configuration, ICS integration, and Cognos reporting. The role requires the ability to independently gather client requirements, design scalable T\&E solutions, and deliver high quality implementations aligned with best practices.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Lead end to end implementation activities including design, configuration, testing, integration, deployment and production support.
* Implement Concur Expense and Request modules with ICS integration to SAP S/4HANA.
* Analyze client business processes and translate them into scalable functional solution designs.
* Design, build, configure, and validate applications based on business requirements.
* Work on integration points, middleware, and ICS configurations related to Concur solutions.
* Lead discussions with relevant stakeholders and client related to system design, integration architecture, interface design, and development.
* Build and optimize Cognos reports as per business needs.
* Create and execute test plans, conduct Unit testing, SIT and support UAT cycle.
* Conduct project kick\-off, requirement gathering and detailed design workshops, design discussions, and technical review sessions with client teams.
* Manage deliverables, timelines, and milestones ensuring seamless project execution.
* Provide hypercare support post go live and resolve issues within defined SLAs.
* Good to have experience with Concur Travel, Detect, Invoice, and App Center integrations.
* Strong technical foundation with the ability to support development and unit testing activities.


**Basic Qualifications**
**Skills and attributes for success**
* Bachelor’s degree: BE / BTech / MCA / MBA / B. Com / equivalent.
* 3 – 7 years of experience in SAP Concur.
* SAP Concur CIP certification – Mandatory.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Strong experience in SAP Concur Implementation (Expense \& Request), advanced configuration, and integration.
* Hands on experience with ICS integration between SAP Concur and SAP S/4HANA / ECC.
* Proficiency in creating custom reports using Cognos Reporting.
* Knowledge of SAP Concur Travel and Invoice modules (preferred).
* Experience in at least two end\-to\-end SAP Concur Implementations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

 Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

 People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

 Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

 How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Engineer - Process Intelligence
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
 Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long\-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
   

  

 For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
   

  

 © 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Design, configure, test, and continuously improve enterprise process intelligence solutions and business process monitoring capabilities using Celonis EMS and related enterprise technologies.
   

  

 Support business transformation initiatives through IT changes, Agile DevOps delivery, and process optimization activities in line with global Information Technology (IT), enterprise architecture, and security standards to enable operational excellence, process transparency, and measurable business value.
   

  

 The role contributes to data\-driven decision making by translating business process requirements into scalable process mining solutions, dashboards, analytics, and actionable insights across global business functions.
   

  

* The Technical Engineer in IT Operations is responsible for translating business process requirements into detailed functional designs, Celonis stories, KPIs, dashboards, and EMS configurations in accordance with enterprise architecture and security standards. Working within projects, operational changes, and Agile DevOps teams, the Functional Engineer coordinates the preparation, review, execution, and testing of process mining solutions while ensuring high\-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment throughout the implementation lifecycle.


 The Technical Engineer actively collaborates with business process owners, implementation partners, and external consultants during the execution of enhancements and deployments. The role contributes to incident resolution, root cause analysis, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to strengthen operational performance and process transparency.
   

  

* The Functional Engineer in Application Delivery is responsible for leading enterprise\-wide process intelligence initiatives and defining scalable process mining solutions across business domains. The role drives strategic transformation programs, establishes governance standards, mentors team members, and partners with Architects and senior stakeholders to design advanced analytics, AI\-enabled process intelligence capabilities, and sustainable optimization roadmaps.


 The Functional Engineer oversees large\-scale implementations and complex operational changes together with strategic partners and cross\-functional teams. The role ensures quality execution, monitors delivery progress, governs testing and deployment activities, and leads
   

  

 continuous improvement, incident management, and process mining best practice adoption across the organization.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Functional Engineer with a strong background in process mining and a proven track record in designing \& implementing impactful process mining use cases. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in using Celonis to analyse, optimize, and transform key business operations, particularly within finance and supply chain functions.
   

  

 You will leverage Celonis Process Intelligence capabilities, AI\-driven insights, and Agentic Automation features to drive digital transformation initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, opportunities for potential savings, and developing advanced Celonis applications, dashboards, and intelligent workflows that enhance performance and achieve business objectives.
   

  

 The role will also contribute to the adoption of AI\-powered process optimization, predictive analytics, intelligent recommendations, and autonomous action orchestration across enterprise processes
   

  

 Key Activities
   

  

**Story specification**
 Translate business process requirements into clear and detailed Celonis solution designs. Own and develop high\-quality stories and configuration specifications for Engineers, Developers, and implementation partners to translate into dashboards, process models, integrations, analytics, and EMS configurations including implementation proposals and deployment planning.
   

  

**Development \& delivery**
 Guide, coordinate, and oversee the preparation, implementation, and deployment of process intelligence solutions and related configurations. Ensure that all internal and external partners follow established standards including process documentation, governance controls, testing procedures, naming conventions, and architectural principles. Review, approve, and control the implementation of new enhancements, dashboards, KPIs, analytics models, and process mining capabilities across enterprise solutions.
   

  

 This results in sustainable, scalable, and business\-aligned solutions delivered in close collaboration with stakeholders, business process owners, and external service providers. Solutions are developed according to enterprise architecture and security standards, while changes are properly prepared, documented, validated, and implemented to deliver operational insights and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**Testing**
 Own and coordinate testing activities for Celonis stories, dashboards, process models, and integrations. Develop and maintain test scenarios, review test outcomes, support user acceptance testing, coordinate business sign\-off, and contribute to release planning and test management activities to ensure reliable and high\-quality deployments.
   

  

**Incident management**
 Perform functional and technical analysis of incidents, data quality issues, and process intelligence disruptions based on business impact and severity. Conduct root cause analysis, document findings, coordinate corrective actions, and oversee deployment of fixes to ensure timely and effective issue resolution and stable operational performance.
   

  

**Process management and improvement**
 Monitor and analyze the performance, adoption, and security of Celonis solutions and related enterprise applications against agreed service and business KPIs. Actively contribute to process optimization initiatives through dashboard development, operational insight visualization, automation, and advanced analytics. Maintain visibility of technical debt and collaborate closely with Domain Architects and delivery teams to continuously improve process intelligence capabilities, DevOps practices, and platform stability.
   

  

**Project support**
 Support project and program managers by taking ownership of process intelligence deliverables including requirements gathering, configurations, dashboards, analytics, testing, and deployment coordination. Define, plan, manage, and execute assigned activities in alignment with IT delivery leads and business stakeholders to ensure efficient realization of project objectives and transformation outcomes.
   

  

**Experience**
* 0–2 years of relevant experience in process mining, analytics, business applications, or IT delivery
* Relevant Bachelor or Master degree
* Understands core Celonis EMS concepts, process mining fundamentals, and assigned enterprise applications within a defined business process area.
* Participates as a member of a project or Agile DevOps team supporting operational enhancements and low\-complexity changes with limited business impact.
* Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering and LLM API integration. Knowledge of AI agents, tool/function calling, multi\-step workflows and agent orchestration. Good SQL skills and understanding of relational data, data models and business data. Ability to consume/build APIs and integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications.
* Performs business and process analysis within a defined process mining scope and contributes to solution design activities.
* Identifies operational bottlenecks, process deviations, and compliance issues within assigned workflows.
* Supports story development, testing, configuration, and deployments with limited business complexity and operational risk.
* Provides internal support and advice regarding Celonis functionality, integrations, and operational issues.

Our talent acquisition process plays an integral part in this journey, as setting the foundations for a diverse environment. **Job Description**
 Job description \-

**Job Description\-**
 We work in an environment where Developers and Testers are more exposed to IT and systems in

* Playwright \+ Python – Strong hands\-on experience
* Rest Assured \+ Java \+ TestNG
* Manual \& Functional Testing
* API Testing
* Regression \& Integration Testing
* Accessibility Testing / WCAG
* Performance Testing / JMeter
* Git and basic CI/CD knowledge
* Agile/Scrum methodology
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills

 Graduate

title: Regulatory Reporting Intermediate Analyst
description:
**About The Organization**
 SMBIC Data and Regulatory Operations Group is a global team operating in over 20 countries, providing essential support to key business lines including Markets, Services, and Wealth Management. We provide an array of services to enable client lifecycle transactions; from relationship establishment, supporting the data demands surrounding instruments and delivering non\-financial reporting to our regulators.
   

  

 The Regulatory Operations Testing Team, within SMBIC Data and Regulatory Operations, rigorously test all system changes to guarantee adherence to regulatory mandates and prevent disruption to existing, critical functionalities.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 We are looking for a Tester to play a key role in ensuring the quality of our non\-financial regulatory reporting changes. As a Tester, you will be responsible for executing and reporting on UAT and regression testing for both new regulatory implementations and ongoing remediation efforts.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Collaboration \& Learning: Work closely with senior testers and business analysts to understand regulatory requirements and system changes.
* Regression Test Coverage: Develop and establish traceability matrix on LLM generated scenarios against regulatory documents and unearth requirements coverage gaps.
* Test Planning Support: Assist in creating and maintaining UAT test plans and scripts.
* Test Execution: Execute UAT scripts accurately, following procedures and documenting results.
* Defect Reporting: Identify and report defects clearly, providing relevant information.
* Defect Triage: Participate in defect triage meetings.
* Defect Retesting: Retest defects after fixes are implemented.
* Test Data/Environment Support: Assist in preparing test data and environments.
* Documentation: Contribute to documenting UAT processes and best practices.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Develop an understanding of non\-financial regulatory reporting requirements and their application.
* Task Management: Follow instructions and complete assigned tasks effectively and efficiently.

 ParentPay Group is Europe’s leading software product company and the UK’s largest education technology business. We are on a mission to bring next\-generation innovation to positively impact on the lives of millions of parents, teachers, and students every day in over 49 countries.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**About ACA:**
 ACA Group is the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. We empower our clients to reimagine GRC and protect and grow their business. Our innovative approach integrates consulting, managed services, and our ComplianceAlpha® technology platform with the specialized expertise of former regulators and practitioners and our deep understanding of the global regulatory landscape.
   

  

**Position Summary:**
 The Principal Consultant, ESG plays a large role in the team’s Data Quality and plays a critical role in delivering high\-quality sustainability and ESG solutions to global real estate clients. This position supports complex data quality and validation initiatives, ensuring the integrity of environmental performance data used for regulatory reporting, ESG disclosures, and industry benchmarking frameworks such as GRESB.
   

  

 The Principal Consultant may take a lead role depending on the complexity and/or scale of the project and may be asked to assist with certain leadership or management tasks, or certain strategic initiatives. They will play a role in maintaining and enhancing the delivery of the firm’s products and services, ensuring high levels of client service and demonstrating technical competence across a range of ESG compliance areas applicable to our clients.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has 5 years (minimum of 3 years) of experience in ESG/Sustainability and is a highly motivated, passionate individual with strong analytical skills.
   

  

**Job Duties:**
* Perform quality assurance and quality control checks on utility consumption, cost, and emissions data.
* Review incoming utility bills for completeness, accuracy, and consistency and validate utility account information, billing periods, meter readings, units of measure, and costs.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve data anomalies, missing values, duplicate records, and inconsistencies.
* Monitor utility data collection across buildings, accounts, and meters to ensure complete coverage and accurate mapping
* Manage and maintain data within ESG reporting and data management platforms.
* Analyze portfolio\-level utility consumption trends and identify performance anomalies
* Resolve complex data issues and provide actionable recommendations.
* Contribute to process automation, workflow optimization, and data governance initiatives.
* Support ESG and GRESB reporting initiatives.


**Preferred Education And Experience**
* Sustainability, Environmental Science, Real Estate, Data Analytics, or a related degree
* 3\-6 years of professional experience in ESG, sustainability, utilities analytics, data quality, real estate operations, consulting, or environmental reporting
* Strong knowledge of ESG/sustainability frameworks (GRESB, ISSB, GHG Protocol)
* Experience working with large datasets and database\-driven application
* Familiarity with ESG data platforms, utility management systems, or sustainability software solutions such as ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager, Conservice, WatchWire or similar systems
* Understanding of utility billing structures, energy consumption metrics, emissions calculations, and carbon accounting principles


**Required Skills And Attributes**
* Entrepreneurial spirit and ability to work independently
* Collaborative and team\-oriented mindset
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Creative thinker and problem\-solver with a positive and flexible attitude
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
* Passion for ESG and sustainability
* High level of proficiency in Microsoft software applications and comfortable working in a tech enabled environment.


**What working at ACA offers:**
 We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical coverage fully funded by ACA for employees and their family as well as access to Maternity \& Fertility and Wellness programs. ACA also provides Personal Accident Insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Employee Discount programs and Employee Resource Groups. You’ll be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Privilege Leave, Casual/Sick Leave, and other leaves of absence to support your physical, financial and emotional well\-being.

title: Integration Analyst
description:
**Who We Are:** 




 Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.
 



  





  





**Integrations Analyst** 




*The largest and most impactful transformation in our 100\+ year history is currently underway at New Balance. We have started a digital revolution, investing in exciting new capabilities for both our customers and associates. One of our primary initiatives is the reimagining of our global integration platforms that will unite our core business processes, aligning the demands of our channel sales with the real\-time status of our supply chain. By unlocking new support functionality and consumer insights, this platform will allow us to anticipate and better serve the needs of our customers. We’re seeking agile thinkers who can quickly adapt in a collaborative, high\-performance culture. Are you ready to join the revolution?* 




**General Summary:** 




 As a Configuration Analyst for integrations, you will build, configure, and maintain EDI and non\-EDI integration solutions on the Partner LINQ platform, contributing to New Balance’s global digital transformation. You will play a central role in migrating legacy IBM Sterling EDI and Cleo Harmony MFT integrations onto Partner LINQ — configuring mappings, orchestration flows, and business rules — helping drive New Balance to be a Top 3 Global Athletic Brand through responsive, standardized integration workflows that support consistent business growth, expand market share, and strengthen brand equity and reputation
 



**MAJOR ACCOUNTABILTIES:** 



* Create and configure mappings, process/orchestration flows, business rules, cross\-reference schemas, and lookups within the PartnerLinQ Design Studio to meet business requirements.
* Convert existing IBM Sterling maps and Cleo MFT flows to PartnerLinQ, leveraging AI Mapping Agent / template\-based tooling to standardize and optimize designs for reuse.
* Perform unit testing on all integrations, coordinate with end\-system teams, and support SIT and UAT cycles, producing test result reports against production sample files.
* Manage controlled promotion of tested configurations (mappings, alerts, dashboards, partnerships) from lower to production environments, validating dependencies and completeness before migration.
* Support white\-glove partner onboarding: gather EDI specifications, IDs, and connection details; build mapping templates; run connection and business\-rule testing.
* Support production deployments and provide post\-go\-live hypercare, troubleshooting transaction and mapping issues and creating SOPs / runbooks.
* Follow approved integration governance patterns, intake, documentation standards, and SLA checkpoints for all net\-new and migrated integrations.



**REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS:** 




 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3 to 5 years of Hands\-on experience configuring EDI/B2B integrations, ideally on PartnerLinQ or a comparable platform (IBM Sterling, Cleo), preferred.
 


* Working knowledge of EDI standards — X12, EDIFACT/EANCOM — and common transaction sets (850, 855, 856, 810, 820, 846\)
* Mapping to/from canonical and flat\-file formats
* Data transformation using XML, JSON, flat files, and XSLT
* Target systems such as D365 F\&O, SAP, SQL
* Transport protocols — AS2, SFTP, API/VAN
* PartnerLinQ Business Rule Engine, Cross Reference Schema, and Artifacts Migration (plus)
* Azure Integration Services (AIS) exposure (plus)
* Git / Azure DevOps (plus)
* Sterling→PLQ or Cleo→PLQ/AIS migration experience (nice to have)
* Solid analytical, documentation, and troubleshooting skills; ability to translate business requirements into detailed configurations. Good communication, critical thinking, and collaboration skills.
* undefined

 For decades we have fostered a unique culture founded on our values with a particular focus on in\-person teamwork and collaboration. * Analyse business and technical requirements and participate in grooming and design discussions to identify testability gaps and risks early.

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (engineering, product, DevOps, design, analysts, support) to align on quality goals and release readiness.
* Monitor and report quality metrics such as test coverage, defect trends, and flaky\-test rates.
* Mentor junior QA team members and promote testing best practices across the team.
* Contribute to performance and load testing efforts where needed.
* Participate in and contribute to agile/scrum ceremonies.



  
 



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  




* 5\+ years of total experience in software testing / quality assurance.
* Strong hands\-on experience in both manual and automation testing. This is not a purely automation or purely manual role.
* Proficiency in automation using Playwright (preferred), or comparable tools such as Cypress, Selenium, or WebdriverIO, with willingness to work primarily in Playwright.
* Good Experience with mobile automation using Appium or comparable tools.
* Solid programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript (preferred), Python, or Java.
* Experience with API testing using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright's API testing capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Proven ability to create test plans, test strategies, and test cases from requirements.
* Experience with version control (Git) and test/defect management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr).
* Experience with load and performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to think like an end user.
* Excellent communication skills and experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Deep understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and the SDLC.
* Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
* Basic SQL knowledge for backend and data validation.
* Familiarity with visual regression, accessibility, or security testing.
* Ability to gel and work in a team and assist junior team members on techno\-functional grounds.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good analytical skills with strong attention to detail.



  





**What We Value in You** 




  




* Strong problem\-solving \& troubleshooting instincts
* Great communication skills. Able to explain technical designs/questions to stakeholders, developers, security, etc.
* Ownership mindset. You care about platform reliability and user experience
* Willingness to learn and adopt new tooling / best practices



  
 



**What Will Make You Stand Out** 




  




* Experience in a SaaS\-based product company.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer or similar certification.

**Position Summary**
 Kaseya is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – DevTest / QA Automation to design, build, and maintain robust automated testing capabilities across enterprise software platforms.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on test automation and engineering quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong programming background and be capable of building test libraries, automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and large scale automated test suites.
   

  

 The role requires an engineer who can leverage AI assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate automation, analyze existing codebases, generate and validate test scenarios, and rapidly expand automated coverage. The candidate should be comfortable working across application code, test infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and production troubleshooting.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be able to take an existing codebase and, with limited direction, deliver hundreds of meaningful automated test cases within weeks, while maintaining quality, reliability, and maintainability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test libraries, utilities, and reusable automation components.
* Build comprehensive automated test suites for enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, services, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Write production\-quality code to automate functional, integration, regression, API, and system\-level testing.
* Analyze existing application codebases and rapidly identify opportunities for automated test coverage.
* Develop and execute large\-scale automation initiatives capable of delivering hundreds of automated test cases in a short timeframe.
* Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents extensively to accelerate test development, test generation, code analysis, debugging, and automation engineering.
* Validate AI\-generated code and test cases through appropriate engineering practices, including code review, execution, debugging, and test\-result analysis.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and test execution infrastructure.
* Work with CI/CD runners, build systems, deployment pipelines, test environments, and automation reporting.
* Develop automation that can run reliably in continuous integration and deployment environments.
* Troubleshoot automation failures, application issues, environment problems, and production defects using logs, metrics, traces, code, and system behavior.
* Participate in production troubleshooting and issue reproduction, including supporting incidents or reproducing customer issues outside standard working hours when required.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, DevOps, operations, and other QA/DevTest engineers to identify quality risks and improve engineering practices.
* Contribute to improvements in testability, observability, reliability, performance, and maintainability of the product.
* Identify gaps in existing test coverage and proactively create automation to prevent regression.
* Review application and test code and provide technical feedback on quality, maintainability, reliability, and automation effectiveness.
* Continuously improve automation speed, stability, coverage, and execution efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of software engineering, SDET, DevTest, or QA automation experience, with strong hands\-on programming experience.
* Programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.
* Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks, test libraries, reusable testing components, and automation infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented programming, data structures, APIs, databases, debugging, and version control.
* Experience developing automated tests for APIs, backend services, web applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution, including familiarity with CI/CD runners and build/deployment infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments, with the ability to troubleshoot applications and test environments in the cloud.
* Experience troubleshooting complex application and production issues using logs, metrics, traces, database queries, and code level debugging.
* Ability to understand an existing codebase and independently build significant automated test coverage.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI assisted development tools/coding agents as part of day to day engineering and test automation work.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply report failures.
* Strong understanding of test automation principles, test design, regression testing, and automation reliability.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and cross functional teams.
* Willingness to support production issue reproduction and troubleshooting outside standard working hours when required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on enterprise SaaS, IT management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, RMM, or other complex software platforms.
* Deep experience with AWS services and cloud\-hosted, data center hosted, or hybrid environments.
* Experience designing and maintaining large\-scale SDET/DevTest automation frameworks.
* Experience with API automation, integration testing, contract testing, service virtualization, or distributed\-system testing.
* Experience with tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, REST\-assured, pytest, JUnit, TestNG, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, including writing queries for test validation and production troubleshooting.
* Experience using AI coding agents to perform tasks such as code generation, test generation, codebase analysis, debugging, refactoring, and test optimization.
* Understanding of application security, scalability, reliability, observability, and distributed\-system behavior.
* Experience building automation capable of operating at significant scale without excessive flakiness or maintenance overhead.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive automation initiatives from design through implementation and production adoption.


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

* Significant experience using AI development tools to:
+ Accurately create and automate test cases
+ Boost code coverage across products
+ Detect bugs early in the development lifecycle
+ Facilitate efficient and correct bug fixes

* Extensive knowledge of OS fundamentals, PC hardware, and resolving issues.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills as well as analytical and problem\-solving abilities.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Prior knowledge of driver components and debugging the internals of driver code.
* Deep understanding of testing fundamentals.
* Strong logic and problem\-solving skills to effectively isolate and regress issues.
* Experience with sophisticated AI or machine learning\-based test automation platforms.
