title: Senior Java Development Engineer - Vice President
description:
Citi's Equities Technology organization is seeking a seasoned and strategic Development Engineer to join the Equities Electronic\- Execution (Electronic Trading) technology team. This role is pivotal in driving the architecture, design, and implementation of our next\-generation automation frameworks. The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on leader with deep technical expertise in modern software development and testing practices, capable of steering our engineering strategy to support complex, high\-performance trading applications within an Agile environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Automation Architecture: Architect, design, and lead the development of sophisticated, scalable, and maintainable test automation frameworks using Java, Python, and BDD tools like Cucumber.
* Strategic Leadership: Define and execute a comprehensive automation strategy that aligns with business goals and technology roadmaps. Drive the adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and maintainability.
* Agile Practice: Champion and implement Agile methodologies to drive efficiency, collaboration, and rapid feedback within the quality engineering process.
* CI/CD and DevOps: Champion the integration of quality engineering into the CI/CD pipeline. Enhance and optimize the pipeline for continuous testing and delivery in a containerized environment (Docker, Openshift).
* Containerization Expertise: Leverage Docker and container orchestration platforms like Openshift to build and manage robust, isolated, and scalable testing environments.
* Platform and System Testing: Oversee the quality assurance for critical trading systems, including the Lightspeed platform, ensuring functionality, performance, and resilience.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with development, DevOps, and business teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
* Innovation: Stay abreast of the latest industry trends in test automation and financial technology. Evaluate and integrate AI\-powered development tools to enhance productivity and test effectiveness.


**Qualifications**
* Extensive experience in a senior software or automation engineering role, with a proven track record of leadership and strategic impact.
* In\-depth knowledge of the FIX protocol is essential.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Java and Python.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with BDD frameworks, particularly Cucumber.
* Strong expertise in container technologies (Docker) and container orchestration platforms (Openshift).
* Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
* Experience in the financial services industry, with exposure to trading systems.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to architect solutions for complex technical challenges.

* Scripting \& Development: JavaScript, Groovy, Python, Shell scripting
* Databases: Oracle, MariaDb; SQL query analysis and database performance analysis
* Database Performance: Oracle AWR/ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning, database CPU/memory/I/O analysis
* Application \& JVM Monitoring: JVM, Garbage Collection (GC), Heap/Thread Dumps, JProfiler, Eclipse MAT or equivalent tools

* Monitor system behaviour during load tests and identify CPU, memory, database, JVM, I/O, and response\-time bottlenecks.
* Perform root\-cause analysis of performance issues using application logs, monitoring tools, AWR/ASH reports, thread dumps, heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Work closely with Developers, QA, DBAs, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.
* Analyse test results and prepare performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Support capacity planning, scalability assessment, and production\-readiness reviews.

* Good understanding of load, stress, endurance, scalability, and volume testing.

title: Quality Inspector - Level II
description:
****Job Summary:****
 Ensures products received or produced meet technical specifications. Works under moderate supervision.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities:****
 Verifies the final quality of products on the production line.
   

  

 Compares the physical characteristics of components, materials, equipment and products to technical specifications to identify defects.
   

  

 Separates products that do not have the desired technical specification, using basic and/or complex measurement techniques and equipment.
   

  

 Documents products that do not meet technical specifications using specified systems.
   

  

 Trains others in the use of measurement equipment, segregation of non\-conforming product and documentation.
   

  

 Follows the norms and standards of quality defined by the Company.
   

  

****Competencies:****
 Action oriented \- Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
   

  

 Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
   

  

 Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 Measurement Science \- Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, “Metrology” e.g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.
   

  

 Quality Process Management \- Proficient application of quality tools and methods (e.g. APQP, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, Capability studies, Process Audit, inspection, test, etc.) to ensure quality of products, processes and services.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

 Laboratory Management \- Leads technical resources while managing the business aspects of a laboratory using measure to control both the technical and business aspects of the organization and assuring the requirements of the appropriate certifications and/or accreditations are met.

 High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
 IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data\-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor\-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.
   

  

 We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview:**
 We are seeking a highly analytical, detail\-oriented Product Analyst to partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering, and business stakeholders to drive product delivery and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This role is critical in translating complex business needs into actionable product requirements, enabling high\-quality delivery across our platform. You will serve as a bridge between business users and technical teams, ensuring clarity, precision, and alignment throughout the product development lifecycle.

**Requirements \& Solution Definition**

* Translate business needs into clear, structured user stories, workflows, and technical specifications
* Support solution design in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams


**Product Delivery Support**
* Partner with Product Managers to break down features into deliverable work for agile teams
* Participate in backlog refinement, story creation, and sprint planning
* Ensure requirements are testable, complete, and aligned to business objectives


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, and client\-facing teams
* Act as a trusted advisor for feature enhancements, process improvements, and issue resolution


**Testing \& Quality Support**
* Support QA efforts by clarifying requirements and validating outcomes
* Assist in defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution tracking


**Documentation \& Release Support**
* Maintain high\-quality product documentation, including requirements, process flows, and release notes
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of documentation standards and processes


**Domain Expertise Development**
* Build deep expertise in pharma/life sciences data, processes, and regulatory requirements
* Apply domain knowledge to improve product quality and usability


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* 2–4 years of experience as a Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into structured, actionable deliverables
* Hands\-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum) and tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Experience working closely with engineering and QA teams
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Proficiency in Excel and other business productivity tools
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience applying AI and automation to improve product development or business processes, including:
+ Using AI tools (e.g., copilots, prompt\-based tools, or data analysis assistants) to accelerate requirements definition, analysis, or documentation
+ Identifying opportunities to automate manual workflows (e.g., data validation, testing support, reporting, or operational processes)
+ Partnering with engineering to define automation\-ready workflows and scalable solutions

* Demonstrated ability to think in terms of efficiency, scalability, and leverage—not just task execution


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare data domains (e.g., pricing, rebates, chargebacks, aggregate spend)
* Familiarity with US healthcare systems and data environments


**What Sets You Apart:**
* Structured thinker who brings clarity to ambiguous problems
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes, not just outputs
* Ability to balance detail orientation with speed and execution
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, evolving product environment
* Collaborative, proactive, and continuously improving mindset


 Additional Information
   

  

**What does IntegriChain have to offer?**
* Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
* Excellent and affordable medical benefits \+ non\-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and much more!
* Robust Learning \& Development opportunities including over 700\+ development courses free to all employees


 IntegriChain is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. IntegriChain is an equal opportunity employer; committed to creating a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

title: Software Automation QA Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

**Automation QA Engineer — Cloud Security Posture Management**
**About the role** 
 Our CSPM platform discovers cloud resources across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI and evaluates them against security controls and compliance benchmarks. You'll own the automation that proves those controls are correct — a control that silently misses a misconfiguration is a customer security risk, not just a bug.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and maintain automated tests in Python (Robot Framework) and Playwright for cloud connectors, the evaluation engine, REST APIs, and UI.
* Validate control logic end\-to\-end — provision intentionally misconfigured cloud resources, verify controls evaluate correctly, and investigate false positives/negatives.
* Verify inventory accuracy across accounts, regions, and resource types.
* Test against real cloud API behavior — pagination, eventual consistency, throttling, and insufficient\-permission cases.
* Manage test environments involving Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Cassandra, and Kafka.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins / GitLab CI); debug failures and participate in code reviews.
* We use AI and LLM\-assisted tooling for test\-case generation and failure triage; you'll help shape where it's trustworthy and where it isn't.


**Required**
* 2\+ years in Software Automation Testing.
* Strong Python and hands\-on Robot Framework experience.
* Playwright or comparable UI automation experience.
* Testing SaaS applications and REST APIs.
* Working experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI), including its APIs and IAM model.
* Strong debugging skills and attention to detail.
* Bachelors in CS/Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.


**Nice to have**
* Multiple cloud providers; cloud security fundamentals (IAM, network rules, encryption, audit logging).
* CIS Benchmarks or compliance frameworks (PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2\).
* Terraform, Docker/Kubernetes.
* Basic understanding of AI/ML testing fundamentals
* Testing AI/ML cloud services or data pipelines.

Job Description (JD)Software QA Intern – INBO Platform
 
 Internship
 



 0–1 Years Experience
 



 Trained QA Candidates
 



 Kiavi SunTechna Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
 



 Pune, Maharashtra, India
 



 Software Quality Assurance (QA)
 


 About Kiavi SunTechna Solutions
 
 Kiavi SunTechna Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is building INBO, an AI\-native ERP and Business Operating System designed for MSMEs and enterprises.
 



 INBO integrates business operations, inventory, warehouse management, accounting, procurement, CRM, HRMS, feedback management, and AI\-powered intelligence into a unified platform.
 



 We are looking for a Software QA Intern who is passionate about software quality, learning new technologies, and building reliable enterprise applications.
 


 Position Overview
 
 We are hiring trained QA candidates with 0–1 year of experience who have a foundational understanding of manual software testing and want to gain practical experience working on a real\-world enterprise SaaS platform.
 



 As a QA Intern, you will work closely with developers, senior QA members, and project stakeholders to identify defects, validate business workflows, and ensure the quality of the INBO platform.
 



 This role is suitable for freshers who have completed QA training, software testing courses, or academic projects in software testing.
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Manual Software Testing
 * Understand business requirements and functional specifications.
* Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing.
* Validate web application features across different modules.
* Identify UI, functional, and workflow\-related defects.
* Verify bug fixes and perform retesting.


 2\. INBO ERP \& Business Application Testing
 
 Work on real\-world business workflows, including:
 


* Inventory and warehouse management.
* Stock entry, GRN, and inventory movements.
* Procurement (MR, PR, PO, RFQ).
* Sales orders and invoicing.
* Accounting and financial workflows.
* CRM and customer feedback management.
* HRMS and employee management.



 Understand how business transactions flow across different modules and verify data accuracy and process consistency.
 


 3\. Defect Reporting \& Tracking
 * Log defects with clear descriptions, reproduction steps, and expected vs. actual results.
* Capture screenshots and supporting evidence.
* Track defects through their lifecycle.
* Collaborate with developers to resolve reported issues.
* Participate in defect review and prioritization discussions.


 4\. API \& Database Testing (Learning Opportunity)
 * Learn and execute basic API testing using Postman.
* Validate HTTP methods, response codes, and API responses.
* Perform basic SQL queries to verify backend data.
* Understand frontend\-to\-backend integration and data consistency.


 5\. Quality Assurance Practices
 * Follow QA processes and testing standards.
* Maintain test execution reports.
* Participate in daily stand\-ups and QA discussions.
* Contribute to improving test coverage.
* Learn automation testing and CI/CD quality practices over time.


 Required Skills \& QualificationsMust Have
 * Completed training in Manual Software Testing / Software QA.
* Basic knowledge of SDLC and STLC.
* Understanding of software testing concepts.
* Knowledge of test case creation and execution.
* Understanding of defect life cycle.
* Familiarity with functional and regression testing.
* Basic knowledge of web applications.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn and work in a team environment.


 Good to Have
 * Basic knowledge of SQL.
* Familiarity with Postman and API testing.
* Understanding of Agile / Scrum methodology.
* Basic knowledge of Jira, Bitbucket, or other issue tracking tools.
* Exposure to automation testing tools such as Selenium or Playwright.
* Knowledge of browser developer tools.


 Skills We Value
 
 Attention to Detail
 



 Ability to identify inconsistencies and unexpected application behavior.
 



 Analytical Thinking
 



 Understand business scenarios and think beyond happy\-path testing.
 



 Communication
 



 Clearly communicate defects, observations, and testing progress.
 



 Learning Mindset
 



 Willingness to learn enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and automation.
 



  





 Internship Duration: 3–6 months (depending on the candidate's learning progress and organizational requirements).
 



 Potential opportunity for full\-time employment based on performance, skills, and business requirements.
 


 What You Will Learn
 
 During the internship, you will gain hands\-on exposure to:
 


* Testing a live enterprise business application.
* End\-to\-end ERP workflows and business processes.
* Manual testing and structured test documentation.
* API testing and SQL\-based data validation.
* Agile development and collaboration with developers.
* Defect management and release quality.
* Practical software QA standards for a SaaS product.


 Candidate Profile
 
 We are looking for candidates who:
 


* Have completed QA training or a software testing course.
* Are recent graduates or candidates with up to 1 year of experience.
* Can understand business requirements and translate them into test scenarios.
* Are willing to take ownership of testing tasks.
* Want to build a long\-term career in Software Quality Assurance.



 Educational Qualification: B.E., B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, MCA, or relevant technical qualification. Freshers with appropriate QA training are encouraged to apply.
 


 How to Apply
 
 Interested candidates can share their updated resume with:
 



 Kiavi SunTechna Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
 



 Subject: Application for Software QA Intern – INBO
 



 share your profile/resume careers@kiavisuntech.com

**Job Description for Lead Engineer – Product (VAVE \& Sustaining)**
**Job Description**
 Lead and coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost\-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform testing and validation of VAVE\-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
* Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post\-cost optimization.
* Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
* Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
* Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost\-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
* Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
* Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
* Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.


**Job Specifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* Experience: 7 to 8 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).
* Hands\-on experience in automation testing tools and programming for test systems.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital circuits, power conversion principles, and common topologies.
* Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
* Familiarity with VAVE methodology, cost optimization principles, and supplier component qualification.
* Proactive, analytical, and result\-oriented, with the ability to think critically and solve problems independently.
* Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal in English).


**Key Skills**
* VAVE (Value Analysis \& Value Engineering) implementation and testing

* Analog \& digital electronics troubleshooting
* Compliance \& certification validation (UL, CE)
* Test plan creation and execution

**The Opportunity**

* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer\-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation


**Technical Skills**
* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF\+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit\-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post\-implementation support


**Industry Knowledge**
* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)

* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real\-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement

* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on\-time delivery

**About The Role**
 The Professional Services Consultant is a hybrid role based out of our Pune offie location. The role works across four areas of PS work, depending on where demand is highest in a given week: helping prospects get value from their free trial, supporting implementation and onboarding, hands\-on technical consulting work across integrations and data migrations, and delivering managed admin services to our client base.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Trial \& Conversion Support**
* Monitor active trial accounts and proactively help prospects reach a meaningful setup milestone before the trial expires
* Provide lightweight, unsolicited setup help — configuration tips, content upload assistance, quick walkthroughs
* Flag high\-intent trial accounts to Sales for follow\-up


**Onboarding \& Implementation Support**
* Support Activate and Operate implementations the way a Customer Enablement Specialist would — user setup, content configuration, admin training
* Log CEM hours against fixed\-fee projects consistent with existing project tracking
* Help customers reach go\-live readiness on schedule


**Technical Consulting**
* Build, configure, and monitor integrations — SFTP, API\-based connectors, and Platform Connector (LPC) work
* Support data migration projects, including field mapping and validation
* Custom coding work: CSS and JavaScript for branding, portal customization, and configuration beyond standard options


**Managed Admin Execution**
* Identify accounts that need help with their administration, establish their managed\-admin needs, and help bring customers back on track with their Litmos set up, workflows and processes.
* Document value delivered to support the renewal/upsell conversation the CEM or AE ultimately owns
* Maintain all documentation in Salesforce


**What Good Looks Like**
* Trial accounts reach a meaningful setup milestone well before expiration, and conversion rate improves against baseline
* Implementation projects supported stay on schedule with clean go\-live readiness
* Technical consulting work (integrations, migrations, custom coding) meets the same quality bar as the existing one\-time consultant team
* A measurable share of at\-risk accounts convert to a paid Managed Admin package at or ahead of renewal


**Requirements**
**Technical**
* Working proficiency in CSS and JavaScript for portal customization and branding work
* Experience with API\-based integrations and data migration projects
* Comfortable scoping and configuring technical work with the same rigor as a senior consultant, not just executing a checklist


**Customer\-Facing \& Process**
* 3–5 years in customer\-facing SaaS support, implementation, onboarding, or renewals
* Comfortable working from data signals (usage, engagement, trial activity) rather than only inbound requests
* Familiarity with LMS administration; Litmos experience strongly preferred
* Salesforce Planhat proficiency for logging project hours, gift tracking, and trial engagement
* Understands scope boundaries across all four functions — this role executes and prepares, it does not own customer relationships or make commercial decisions

 You will work on the engineering systems that evaluate AI models, identify model and pipeline regressions before production, monitor model behavior after deployment, and provide measurable signals around accuracy, reliability, drift, and inference cost.

 • Build cost monitoring for ML workloads and identify factors affecting inference cost, latency, and model performance.
 



 • Investigate model\-quality issues and contribute to root\-cause analysis and platform health reporting.
 



 • Work with Computer Vision, AI Platform, and Agentic AI teams to define evaluation and observability requirements for new model generations.

**What We’re Looking For** 




 • 5\+ years of software engineering experience with strong production\-quality Python skills.
 



 • Hands\-on experience building or operating ML infrastructure, MLOps, model evaluation, monitoring, or observability systems.
 



 • Experience building or operating model evaluation or regression\-detection systems in production.
 



 • Strong understanding of the ML lifecycle: training → evaluation → deployment → monitoring.
 



 • Experience with production ML platforms and real operational constraints.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with tools such as MLflow, Weights \& Biases/Weave, Datadog, or equivalent platforms.
 



 • Strong understanding of automated testing, system design, code reviews, and production software engineering.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Computer Vision, Video AI, VLM, LLM evaluation, or multimodal AI experience.
 



 • Experience with video or event\-based AI pipelines.

 • Experience with IoT, smart\-home, connected devices, robotics, or consumer technology products.

title: Quality Analyst & Trainer (Appointment Generation - Voice)
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Quality Analyst \& Trainer is a dual\-role professional responsible for maximizing the performance of the appointment generation team. This role involves monitoring, evaluating, and scoring customer interactions to ensure compliance and quality standards. Simultaneously, you will design, deliver, and refresh training programs that equip agents with the skills needed to overcome objections, build pipelines, and book high\-quality appointments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Quality Assurance \& Monitoring** 



* Evaluate Interactions: Monitor recorded and live outbound/inbound calls, emails, and chat interactions to evaluate communication skills, script adherence, and lead qualification accuracy.
* Calibrate Standards: Participate in regular calibration sessions with team leaders and management to ensure consistent grading across the department.
* Provide Feedback: Conduct regular, constructive 1\-on\-1 coaching sessions with agents to review performance, highlight strengths, and address areas for improvement.
* Analyze Trends: Identify common performance gaps, compliance risks, or script bottlenecks and report findings to operations management.



  





**Training \& Development** 



* Onboarding Delivery: Lead new\-hire training batches, focusing on product/service knowledge, pitch delivery, objection handling, and CRM navigation.
* Continuous Learning: Create and deliver refresher training modules, workshops, and huddles based on QA data trends and changing campaign requirements.
* Content Creation: Develop and update training materials, including playbooks, call scripts, objection\-handling guides, and multimedia learning tools.
* Performance Tracking: Measure the effectiveness of training interventions by tracking the "nesting" performance and ramp\-up time of new hires.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Experience** 



* Proven Track Record: Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a Quality Analyst, Trainer, or Team Lead specifically in an appointment setting, lead generation, or outbound sales BPO environment.
* Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of the appointment generation sales funnel, including gatekeeper navigation, cold calling strategies, and qualifying criteria (e.g., BANT).



  





**Core Skills** 



* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills with a neutral or highly adaptable accent.
* Coaching \& Facilitation: Strong public speaking and classroom management skills, with the ability to deliver constructive feedback without demoralizing agents.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret QA metrics, conversion data, and KPIs to pinpoint exact root causes of low performance.
* Technical Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with QA software, Call Center Dialers (e.g., Five9, Vicidial), CRMs (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), and Learning Management Systems (LMS).

title: Sr. Engineer Reliability Engineering XI
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Sr. Engineer – Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing
 **product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab** 
 . The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The role will work closely with
 **Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross\-functional teams** 
 to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life\-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab.
* Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements.
* Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data\-acquisition systems.
* Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions.
* Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures.
* Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions.
* Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability.
* Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions.
* Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams.
* Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities.
* Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers.
* Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure.
* Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation.
* Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required.
* Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting.


 Key Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing.
* Hands\-on experience with reliability and environmental testing.
* Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing.
* Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing.
* Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment.
* Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test\-system vs. product failures.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
* Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices.
* Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes.
* Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline.
* Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions.
* Hands\-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred.
* Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data\-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Reliability \& Failure Analysis
* Laboratory \& Test Management
* Technical Problem Solving
* Data Analysis
* Root Cause Analysis
* Product Testing \& Validation
* Project Ownership
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Technical Documentation
* Decision Making


 Key KPIs
   

  

* On\-time completion of reliability and qualification testing
* Reliability test execution quality and accuracy
* Reduction in repeat/recurring test failures
* Timely identification and closure of reliability issues
* Effectiveness of RCA and corrective actions
* Laboratory equipment availability and utilization
* Compliance with testing, calibration, safety, and documentation requirements
* Contribution to product reliability and design improvements

title: Data Quality Officer
description:
**About The Role**
**As a
 **Data Quality Officer for HR \& Reference Data** 
 , you will be the key enabler in maximizing the value and trustworthiness of our most critical enterprise domains: our workforce information and core reference datasets.**
**You will act as a proactive partner, collaborating closely with business and technical teams. A critical part of your role is bridging perspectives—from HR business partners to IT architects—into clear, actionable data analysis.**
**Your mission is to resolve data issues and nurture a proactive prevention mindset across the organization. You will translate HR processes and Reference Data requirements into formal data quality policies, rules, and governance standards. By storylining data health metrics and serving as a data provocateur when needed, you will drive the continuous improvement of our core data foundation.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Domain\-Specific Insight Generation \& Profiling:
+ Perform deep\-dive root cause analysis on HR datasets (e.g., employee lifecycle, payroll interfaces, org structures) and Reference Data (e.g., enterprise code tables, locations, job classifications, cost centers) to isolate systemic, process, or integration issues.
+ Conduct thorough data profiling on critical master and reference datasets to detect anomalies, cross\-system discrepancies, orphan records, and data drift.
+ Document findings and quantify the business impact of poor data quality on operational HR, compliance, reporting, and downstream integrations.

* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Standard Setting:
+ Work closely with HR Data Stewards, Data Governance, and IT to define, document, and enforce clear data quality rules and reference data standards.
+ Translate HR business rules and Reference Data governance policies into precise technical specifications for automated validation and monitoring tools.
+ Act as the primary liaison between business domain owners and technical teams, ensuring alignment on data lineage and data definitions.

* Monitoring, Reporting \& Governance:
+ Maintain domain\-specific Data Quality Dashboards (e.g., tracking HR data completeness, reference data synchronization) for clear visibility across business units.
+ Track and report HR and Reference Data quality KPIs to leadership, driving transparency and accountability.
+ Support reference data management processes, ensuring code values, mappings, and taxonomies remain synchronized across target applications.

* Remediation \& Prevention:
+ Collaborate with IT and HR Tech teams to define requirements for data cleansing, automated enrichment, and exception management.
+ Support business teams at the point of data entry/creation to improve source data quality and minimize manual workarounds.


****Your Profile****
* Boundary Spanner: Ability to connect HR business processes and enterprise reference data structures with backend technical architectures.
* Influencer \& Storyteller: Skilled at translating complex data anomalies into compelling narratives for HR leadership and business managers.
* Collaborator: A strong team player dedicated to building cross\-functional alignment across HR Operations, Enterprise Data Management/Governance, and IT.
* Mindset: Detail\-oriented, persistent, and proactive about driving data transparency and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, HR Analytics, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Data Quality Officer, Data Governance Analyst, or Data Steward, with direct experience handling HR data, Master Data Management (MDM), or Reference Data domains.
* Essential: Strong proficiency in SQL for complex data querying, profiling, and joining datasets across multi\-table environments.
* Hands\-on experience with modern HR Information Systems (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and Reference Data concepts (code lists, hierarchies, mapping tables).
* Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with global teams.


**Preferred Skills**
* Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks (Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Cataloging).
* Experience using scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automated data checks or profiling is a plus.
* Knowledge of global HR data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, local DPDP regulations).

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading‑book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking‑book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front‑to‑back\-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision‑making for clients with capital‑markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high‑impact capital‑markets engagements across global banks, broker‑dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
   

  

 EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large\-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.

* MRM (SR 11\-7 experience) / Model Audit / Model governance along with Gen AI / Traditional AI
* Deep understanding of various neural network architectures, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), transformers, and generative adversarial networks (GANs), along with their applications in supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
* Proficiency in the development / validation of state\-of\-the\-art generative AI models, including RAG structures, as well as experience with natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs), with skills in data preprocessing, model training, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation metrics specific to generative tasks for creative content generation and data synthesis.
* Utilize leading AI platforms like OpenAI, Azure GPT, Google Gemini, LLaMA, or Mistral, with proficiency in at least one platform.
* Conduct comprehensive testing and evaluation of AI models on tasks such as text summarization, content generation, and other NLP applications.
* Experience in performance testing of AI models, including evaluation for hallucinations, toxicity, bias, robustness, adversarial attacks, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI model development and deployment.
* Demonstrate ability to learn and apply new concepts, specifically in the area of financial risk management.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PySpark and PyTorch. Knowledge in AutoML tools which are used for automating the machine learning pipeline and Auto Kubernetes for managing containerized applications.
* Experience with cloud\-based platforms for building, training, and deploying machine learning models, such as AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Cloud AI.
* Experience is writing validation reports as per MRM practices.


**What We Look For**
* Undergraduate (4\-year degree) or master’s or Ph.D. in Mathematics, Engineering, Computational Finance, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field with hands\-on experience.
* Relevant certifications in AI/RAI from GARP/ Quantitative courses such as CQF.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: FinApps Invoice and Cash Technical Analyst
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Finance Applications team is part of the Core Applications unit within DNV’s Global Shared Services IT. The team focuses on establishing, maintaining, and supporting a full overview of finance applications to ensure stable end\-to\-end operations across the globe. With Oracle eBusiness Suite at its core, additional products that complement key processes such as purchasing, banking, credit collection, and invoicing are also part of the finance suite. A well\-functioning and up\-to\-date finance system acts as a key engine to support our organization’s commercial and financial commitments, with integrations to our business production and reporting tools.

The team works as one unit regardless of location, and work is prioritized based on customer needs and skills, not location. The Invoice and Cash team covers systems and solutions related to Cash Management, Invoicing/E\-invoicing, Collections, and Banking, with the main product supported being Oracle eBusiness Suite, and requires close input with other FA streams.

title: QA Analyst  (Customer Support & AI)

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer
 



  





**Team:** 
 Healthcare EHR product engineering ·
 **Work model:** 
 WFO ( 5 days )·
 **Level:** 
 Senior individual contributor ·
 **Focus:** 
 test automation and AI\-augmented quality
 



  





 Role summary
 



  





 A senior QA engineer who builds automated test suites, embeds quality in an AI\-augmented (AI\-PDLC) delivery model, and drives the move from manual to automated testing for a healthcare EHR platform.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 



  




* Build and maintain automated test suites (for example Playwright) integrated into CI/CD.
* Convert manual regression into reliable automated coverage on the critical paths.
* Embed in a squad: help write and refine acceptance criteria during the working session, and start testing as soon as the first build is ready.
* Use AI to generate tests, then validate that output rigorously — catching false positives and coverage gaps.
* Test AI\-backed product features: design evaluation checks for non\-deterministic behavior, including scenarios exercised from outside the code under test.
* Manage test data, including compliant synthetic data for a regulated (HIPAA) domain.



  





 Required skills and experience
 



  




* 5\+ years in software QA / test automation, with hands\-on framework build and maintenance (not only test execution).
* Proficiency with a modern automation framework (Playwright or equivalent, such as Selenium or Cypress) integrated into CI/CD.
* Programming for test automation in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
* Strong test strategy and risk\-based design, with fluency across API, UI, and integration testing.
* Hands\-on AI\-assisted or prompt\-driven test generation, plus the discipline to validate what the AI produces.
* Experience testing AI, machine\-learning, or LLM\-backed features — handling non\-determinism and designing evaluation/oracle checks such as golden sets and groundedness.
* A track record of converting manual regression into reliable automated coverage (shift\-left), working embedded in a cross\-functional team.



  





 Preferred qualifications (nice to have)
 



  




* ISTQB Foundation (CTFL) or AI Testing (CT\-AI) certification.
* Healthcare or other regulated\-domain testing, and synthetic test data (for example Synthea/FHIR).
* Performance testing, contract testing, or self\-healing test tooling.



  





 What a strong candidate looks like
 



  





 Has personally built automation up from a low baseline, can show AI\-assisted tests they wrote and then validated, and has tested at least one AI or machine\-learning feature with an evaluation harness rather than manual spot\-checks.
 



  





 Location and work model
 



  





 Hybrid, working within the product engineering team on its collaboration hours. This role is early in an automation\-first transition, so you will be building coverage from a modest baseline — a chance to set the standard rather than inherit it.
 



  





 Compensation
 



  





 Competitive compensation for a senior QA engineer, benchmarked to the local market. Specific range shared early in the process and in line with applicable pay\-transparency requirements.
 



 Equal opportunity and accommodation
 



 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and evaluate candidates on their ability to perform the essential functions of the role. We provide reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities — please let us know if you need one during the process.

title: Electrical & Electronics VAVE - Product Testing
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description for** 
**Engineer – Product Testing(VAVE)**
**Job Description**
 Coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost\-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform testing and validation of VAVE\-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
* Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post\-cost optimization.
* Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
* Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
* Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost\-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
* Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
* Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
* Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.


**Job Specifications**
* Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* Experience: 5 to 6 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).

**Company Description** 
 Sonaca Industries Pvt. Ltd. is a leading aluminium scrap recycling company based in Chakan, Pune, Maharashtra, specializing in premium\-quality aluminium ingots. The company operates a state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facility with advanced German technology and a robust monthly melting capacity of 1,200 MT. Sonaca focuses on low iron (Low Fe) aluminium alloys designed for Gravity Die Casting (GDC) applications, serving both automotive and non\-automotive sectors. Its alloys are recognized for consistency, metallurgical precision, and performance. Guided by innovation, sustainability, and strict quality standards, Sonaca promotes responsible recycling and circular manufacturing practices.

 The Management Representative – Quality is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Khed. The individual will be responsible for overseeing the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, applicable standards, and customer requirements. Key responsibilities include independently handling internal audits and coordinating customer, certification, surveillance, and external audits; managing CAPA, root cause analysis, and key quality metrics; and preparing and reviewing quality documentation and audit records. The role also involves supporting management reviews, facilitating cross\-functional communication on quality issues, coordinating quality\-related training, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The MR – Quality will work closely with operations, maintenance, and leadership teams to strengthen quality awareness, improve production processes, ensure QMS effectiveness, and support customer satisfaction. Internal Auditor certification and relevant experience in QMS and audit handling are preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 ·      Relevant experience in Quality Management Systems (QMS) within a manufacturing industry.

 ·      Experience in conducting and handling internal audits independently.
 



 ·      Experience in coordinating and handling customer, certification, and surveillance audits.

description:
**Job Description**
 Position Overview
   

  

 The MDM Developer is a solid, independent contributor who builds and supports MDM platform features end\-to\-end. Owns features from development through production support under the “you build it, you support it” model. Works with moderate guidance from senior team members on complex design decisions but independently delivers sprint commitments and resolves production issues within their domain.
   

  

 Platform Development \& Enhancement
   

  

* Build and configure MDM platform features across assigned domains
* Implement match/merge/survivorship rules based on design specifications
* Build and maintain hierarchy structures and relationship configurations
* Build stewardship workflows and business rules per design specifications
* Implement region\-specific configurations including conditional attributes, validation rules, and approval routing per design specifications
* Build and maintain custom data entry screens and validation rules per design specifications
* Execute data mapping and onboarding for new sources per established patterns
* Execute data migrations and bulk operations per migration plans
* Implement platform enhancements and optimizations
* Participate in design discussions and raise technical concerns


 Platform Modernization
   

  

* Execute modernization tasks per established plans and timelines
* Implement data mapping per specifications during modernization phases
* Perform regression testing and report discrepancies during modernization


 Production Support, Troubleshooting \& Incident Resolution
   

  

* Own production support for features you built — resolve incidents within SLAs
* Resolve data issues within your domain; escalate cross\-system issues with root cause context
* Analyze application and database logs to identify issue root cause
* Identify patterns in recurring issues and propose permanent fixes
* Debug data flows within your domain to identify where failures occur
* Resolve defects in match/merge configuration and data processing logic
* Execute data reconciliation tasks and validate synchronization
* Collaborate with adjacent teams (data lake, ERP) when issues span system boundaries
* Share knowledge on resolved issues through documentation and team sessions


 Testing \& Quality
   

  

* Develop and execute test cases for SIT and UAT
* Perform system integration testing for assigned features
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
* Refactor code to improve readability and performance
* Address technical debt in assigned areas
* Use CI/CD pipelines for deployments and troubleshoot pipeline failures
* Perform post\-production validation for your releases; execute rollback procedures per established plans
* Participate in DR testing and validate recovery procedures


 Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Working knowledge of data security, information security practices, and SOX compliance procedures


**Required Qualifications**

* 3\+ years experience with data migrations and bulk operations
* 3\+ years experience with data mapping and integration tools (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, MuleSoft)
* 3\+ years experience using CI/CD pipelines and troubleshooting failures (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
* 2\+ years experience with log analysis and monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, ELK Stack, Datadog, CloudWatch)
* 2\+ years experience with incident management using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
* Experience working across at least 2 MDM domains
* Strong knowledge of SDLC: requirements, development, testing (unit, SIT, UAT), CI/CD, change management, release management


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Multi\-domain MDM experience
* Manufacturing industry experience
* Informatica MDM or Reltio platform experience
* Familiarity with event\-driven architecture and APIs
* Awareness of AI/ML applications in MDM
* Familiarity with graph database concepts
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration
* Experience working with adjacent data teams
* Agile/Scrum delivery experience

title: QA Engineer, Trading Systems
description:
QA Engineer, Trading Systems
 



  





**Location** 
 : Pune 
 



**Experience** 
 : 1 \- 3 years
 



**Engagement** 
 : Full\-time, in\-house
 



**Reports To** 
 : Head of Algo Trading / Founder
 



  





**About AJ Algo** 




  






 AJ Algo
 
 runs a portfolio of automated trading bots across Forex (MT4/MT5\), crypto exchanges, and equity/F\&O broker APIs. We build and operate systems that don't just generate trading signals, they execute them reliably, enforce risk discipline in code, and stay resilient around the clock. We're a small, hands\-on team where engineering rigor and calibrated scepticism matter as much as trading performance.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 You will own quality across our trading infrastructure, where bugs don't just break a feature, they can cost real money. Your job is to make sure every order, every risk check, and every model deployment has been genuinely tried to break before it touches a live account.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Test the full order lifecycle: signal generation, risk checks, order routing, fill confirmation, and position tracking
 



 Validate risk management logic: position sizing, daily loss limits, drawdown stops, and margin safeguards, including edge cases like non\-USD\-quoted symbols and correlated exposure
 



 Test failure scenarios explicitly: rejected orders, partial fills, requotes, slippage, disconnects, and stale prices
 



 Verify reconciliation logic between bot\-held positions and broker/exchange records
 



 Test across multiple venues (MT4/MT5, crypto exchange APIs, equity/F\&O broker APIs) and catch behaviour that doesn't generalise across them
 



 Build and maintain automated test suites for money\-touching code, including unit tests for risk calculations
 



 Test monitoring and alerting: confirm the right severity triggers the right alert, and that silent failures don't slip through
 



 Validate ML model deployments: check that walk\-forward or purged cross\-validation was used correctly, and that shadow to small\-allocation to full\-allocation rollouts are gated properly
 



 Test server and terminal recovery scenarios: restarts, reconnections, and failover, confirming positions are reconciled before new trading resumes
 



 Log clear, reproducible bugs with steps, expected versus actual, and evidence
 



 Own the release checklist and sign off before anything ships to a live trading account
 



  





**Must\-Haves** 




 Manual testing fundamentals: test cases, regression suites, bug reporting
 



 Hands\-on automation experience (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Python\-based test frameworks like pytest)
 



 API testing and comfort reading JSON responses; experience with Postman or similar
 



 Basic SQL for verifying trade and position data
 



 Comfort with financial/numerical edge cases: rounding, lot sizing, tick values, and precision errors
 



 Ability to work directly with developers rather than throwing bugs over a wall
 



 A conservative, sceptical mindset: comfortable blocking a release when something is ambiguous rather than assuming it's fine
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 Experience testing trading systems, fintech, or other money\-touching applications
 



 Familiarity with MT4/MT5, crypto exchange APIs, or broker APIs
 



 Understanding of basic risk management concepts (position sizing, stop losses, margin, leverage)
 



 Experience testing ML model outputs where results aren't identical on every run
 



 Running tests in a CI pipeline on every merge
 



 Basic performance or load testing, especially around latency\-sensitive execution paths
 



  





**Share Your Resume** 




 Interested candidates can share their resume with us at: admin@ajems.com
